muyesser-irab:118-118.t:
﴿إن تعذبهم فإنهم عبادك﴾: إن is conditional; تعذبهم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فإنهم﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis; إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the hāʾ is its noun, and عبادك is its khabar (predicate); the conditional sentence is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وإن تغفر لهم فإنك أنت العزيز الحكيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, إن is conditional, تغفر is the protasis, jussive, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تغفر. ﴿فإنك﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and the clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; إنّ is an abrogating particle, the kāf is its noun, أنت is a mubtadaʾ (subject), العزيز is the khabar, and الحكيم a second khabar; the clause ﴿أنت العزيز الحكيم﴾ is the khabar of ﴿إن﴾. Or ﴿أنت﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), العزيز is the khabar of ﴿إن﴾ and الحكيم a second khabar. The conditional sentence is conjoined, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:119-119.t:
﴿قال الله هذا يوم ينفع الصادقين صدقهم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the demonstrative clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); هذا is the mubtadaʾ (subject), يوم is the khabar (predicate), the clause ينفع is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation (iḍāfa); الصادقين is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and صدقهم is a postponed fāʿil (agent).
﴿لهم جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها أبدا﴾: the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar; جنات is the postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause تجري is a naʿt (adjective) of جنات; من تحتها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجري; الأنهار is the fāʿil; خالدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and أبدًا is an adverb of time attached to خالدين.
﴿رضي الله عنهم ورضوا عنه ذلك الفوز العظيم﴾: ﴿رضي الله﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. عنهم: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿رضي﴾. The clause ﴿رضي الله عنهم﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿ورضوا عنه﴾ is conjoined to it. ذلك: mubtadaʾ; الفوز: khabar; and العظيم: an adjective.

muyesser-irab:120-120.t: ﴿لله ملك السماوات والأرض وما فيهن وهو على كل شيء قدير﴾: the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; لله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ملك السماوات والأرض is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the wāw is a conjunction; ما is a relative noun conjoined to ملك; فيهن is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, قدير is its khabar, and على كل شيء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قدير.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿وأن احكم بينهم بما أنزل الله﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; or it is a conjunction joining to «الكتاب». «أن» and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar), accusative by removal of the preposition, and what the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) is omitted, i.e. «ووصَّيناك بأن احكم» ("and We enjoined you to judge"). Or the interpreted maṣdar is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, the implied form being «وحكمك بما أنزل الله أمرنا وقولنا» ("and your judging by what Allah has sent down is Our command and Our word"); or you may supply it by saying: «ومن الواجب حكمك بما أنزل الله» ("and among the obligations is your judging by what Allah has sent down"). «بينهم» is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «بما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿احكم﴾; and the clause «أنزل الله» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا تتبع أهواءهم واحذرهم أن يفتنوك﴾: The clause is conjoined to ﴿احكم﴾. «لا» is prohibitive, and «تتبع» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾; «أهواءهم» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «واحذرهم» is also conjoined. «أن» is a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle, and ﴿يفتنوك﴾ is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by «أن»; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf is the direct object. The interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يفتنوك﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. «من فتنتهم إياك» ("from their tempting you"); or the interpreted maṣdar is a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) from the hāʾ in ﴿واحذرهم﴾, because they comprised the temptation; or it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), supposing the lām of cause and the negating «لا» [Translator's note: i.e. «لئلا يفتنوك», "lest they tempt you"].
﴿عن بعض ما أنزل الله إليك﴾: The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يفتنوك﴾. «ما» is a relative noun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause «أنزل الله» is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and «إليك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أنزل».
﴿فإن تولوا فاعلم أنما يريد الله أن يصيبهم ببعض ذنوبهم﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. «إن» is conditional; «تولوا» is a past verb and its fāʿil, and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). The fāʾ links the apodosis, and the clause «اعلم» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). «أنما» is the restraining «ما» with the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa); it, together with what falls in its scope, stands in place of the two objects of «اعلم». «يريد» is an imperfect verb, and ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil. «أن» is a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle, and «يصيبهم» is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by «أن»; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يصيبهم﴾ is the object of «يريد». «ببعض» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿يصيبهم﴾.
﴿وإن كثيرا من الناس لفاسقون﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and «كثيرا» is its noun; ﴿من الناس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كثيرا﴾. The lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «فاسقون» is the khabar of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿أفحكم الجاهلية يبغون﴾: The speech is conjoined to what preceded. The hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval, and the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something implied that the context requires, i.e. «أيتولون عن حكمك فيبغون حكم الجاهلية؟» ("Do they turn away from your judgement and so seek the judgement of the Jāhiliyya?"). «حكم» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed before His words ﴿يبغون﴾; «الجاهلية» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and «يبغون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿ومن أحسن من الله حكما لقوم يوقنون﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. «من» is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أحسن» is its khabar (predicate); «من الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أحسن»; «حكمًا» is a tamyīz (specification); «لقوم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); or the lām has the sense of «عند» ("in the view of") and is attached to «أحسن», i.e. «عند قوم يوقنون» ("in the view of people who are certain"); and the clause «يوقنون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم».

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تتخذوا اليهود والنصارى أولياء﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle; «أيّ» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; «ها» is for drawing attention; «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; «آمنوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position. «لا» is prohibitive, and «تتخذوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾, and the wāw is the fāʿil; «اليهود» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «النصارى» is conjoined to «اليهود», and «أولياء» is a second direct object. The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿بعضهم أولياء بعض﴾: «بعضهم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أولياء بعض» is the khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is a naʿt of «أولياء», or it is an initial clause.
﴿ومن يتولهم منكم فإنه منهم﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. «من» is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; «يتولهم» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; ﴿منكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فإنه﴾: the fāʾ is linking, «أن» [Translator's note: so in the source; the particle in the text is «إنّ»] is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is its noun; ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to its omitted khabar. The nominal clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the protasis together with its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿من﴾.
﴿إن الله لا يهدي القوم الظالمين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the Divine Name is its noun; «لا» is negating, «يهدي» is an imperfect verb, «القوم» is the direct object, and «الظالمين» is a naʿt. The clause is causal (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿فترى الذين في قلوبهم مرض يسارعون فيهم﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive, and the speech after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; or it is a conjunction, and the speech is conjoined to His words ﴿إن الله لا يهدي القوم الظالمين﴾, with no grammatical position. «ترى» is an imperfect verb, and «الذين» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «في قلوبهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first, and «مرض» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later; the nominal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The clause «يسارعون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), taking the seeing to be visual, or a second direct object, taking the seeing to be cognitive. «فيهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «يسارعون».
﴿يقولون نخشى أن تصيبنا دائرة﴾: The clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the pronoun of ﴿يسارعون﴾. The clause «نخشى» is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). «أن» is a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle, and ﴿تصيبنا﴾ is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by «أن»; ﴿نا﴾ is the direct object; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن تصيبنا﴾ is the object of «نخشى»; and «دائرة» is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿فعسى الله أن يأتي بالفتح أو أمر من عنده﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive. «عسى» is one of the verbs of hope and works as ﴿كان﴾ works (kāna and its sisters); ﴿الله﴾ is its noun, and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يأتي﴾ is its khabar. The clause ﴿فعسى الله...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position. «أو أمر» is conjoined to «الفتح», and ﴿من عنده﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «أمر».
﴿فيصبحوا على ما أسروا في أنفسهم نادمين﴾: The fāʾ is a conjunction or causal; «يصبحوا» is in the subjunctive by being conjoined to «يأتي». «يصبحوا» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, and the wāw is its noun; ﴿على ما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «نادمين»; the clause «أسروا» has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; «في أنفسهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أسروا»; and «نادمين» is the khabar of ﴿أصبح﴾.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿ويقول الذين آمنوا أهؤلاء الذين أقسموا بالله جهد أيمانهم﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. «يقول الذين» is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The hamza is for the interrogative of wonder; the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «الذين» is the khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). The clause «أقسموا» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and «بالله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أقسموا». «جهد» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. «أقسموا بالله مجتهدين في أيمانهم» ("they swore by Allah, exerting themselves in their oaths"); or it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it has the sense of the maṣdar, and the meaning is «أقسموا إقسامَ اجتهادٍ في اليمين» ("they swore an oath of exertion in swearing"). «أيمانهم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إنهم لمعكم﴾: The clause has no [grammatical] position because it is the answer to the oath [Translator's note: the source reads «لا محل لأنها», evidently missing «لها من الإعراب»]. «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the hāʾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and «معكم» is an adverb attached to the omitted khabar of «إن».
﴿حبطت أعمالهم فأصبحوا خاسرين﴾: A resumptive clause with no grammatical position. «أعمالهم» is the fāʿil of «حبطت»; the fāʾ is a conjunction; «أصبحوا» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw is its noun, and «خاسرين» is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا من يرتد منكم عن دينه فسوف يأتي الله بقوم يحبهم ويحبونه﴾: The speech is resumptive with no grammatical position. «يا» is a vocative particle; «أيّ» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; «ها» is for drawing attention; «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; «آمنوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position. «مَن» is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); «يرتد» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the sukūn; «منكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and «عن دينه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «يرتد». The fāʾ links the apodosis, and the clause ﴿سوف يأتي الله﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the protasis together with its apodosis is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿مَن﴾. «يأتي الله» is a verb and its fāʿil; «بقوم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «يأتي»; the clause «يحبهم» is a naʿt of «قوم»; and the clause «يحبونه» is conjoined to the clause «يحبهم».
﴿أذلة على المؤمنين أعزة على الكافرين﴾: «أذلة» is a second naʿt (adjective) of «قوم», and «على المؤمنين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أذلة»; «أعزة» is a third naʿt, and «على الكافرين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أعزَّة».
﴿يجاهدون في سبيل الله ولا يخافون لومة لائم﴾: The clause «يجاهدون» is a fourth naʿt (adjective) of «قوم», and the clause ﴿ولا يخافون﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿يجاهدون﴾, so it is in effect a fifth naʿt.
﴿ذلك فضل الله يؤتيه من يشاء﴾: The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. The demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «فضل الله» is its khabar (predicate); the clause «يؤتيه» is a second khabar, or it is resumptive with no grammatical position. The hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «من» is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as the second direct object of «يؤتيه».
﴿والله واسع عليم﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «واسع» is a first khabar (predicate), and «عليم» is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t:
﴿إنما وليكم الله ورسوله والذين آمنوا﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «إنما» is the restraining «ما» with the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa); «وليكم» is a khabar (predicate) placed first, and ﴿الله﴾ is a nominative mubtadaʾ (subject); or «وليكم» is the mubtadaʾ and the Divine Name is the khabar. «رسوله» is conjoined to ﴿الله﴾, and «الذين آمنوا» is likewise conjoined to ﴿الله﴾; the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿الذين يقيمون الصلاة ويؤتون الزكاة﴾: The relative noun is a badal (substitute) from «الذين»; the clause «يقيمون» is the ṣila of «الذين», with no grammatical position; «الصلاة» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and «يؤتون الزكاة» is conjoined to what precedes it.
﴿وهم راكعون﴾: The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «هم» is a mubtadaʾ and «راكعون» is the khabar, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). Or the wāw is a conjunction and the clause is conjoined to what preceded it, falling within the ṣila of the relative noun [Translator's note: the source reads «مندرجة في خبر الصلة», literally "within the khabar of the ṣila"], with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t:
﴿ومن يتول الله ورسوله والذين آمنوا﴾: The wāw is resumptive. «من» is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); «يتولّ» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «الله» is its object; «رسوله» is conjoined to «الله»; and «الذين آمنوا» is also conjoined.
﴿فإن حزب الله هم الغالبون﴾: The fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and «حزب الله» is its noun; ﴿هم﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and «الغالبون» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن». Or ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and «الغالبون» is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾, and the clause ﴿هم الغالبون﴾ is the khabar of ﴿إن﴾. The clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis together with its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿من﴾. Or the apodosis is omitted because the speech indicates it, i.e. «يغلب» ("he will prevail"), and His words ﴿فإن حزب الله هم الغالبون﴾ indicate it. The clause ﴿ومن يتول الله...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تتخذوا الذين اتخذوا دينكم هزوا ولعبا﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «يا» is a vocative particle; «أيّ» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; «ها» is for drawing attention; «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; «آمنوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position. «لا» is prohibitive, and «تتخذوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا», and the wāw is the fāʿil; «الذين» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause ﴿اتخذوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «دينكم» is the first direct object, «هزوًا» is the second direct object, and «لعبًا» is conjoined to ﴿هزوًا﴾.
﴿من الذين أوتوا الكتاب من قبلكم والكفار أولياء﴾: «من الذين»: the preposition and its genitive noun are a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the first relative noun, or from the fāʿil of «اتخذوا». The clause «أوتوا» is the ṣila of «الذين», with no grammatical position; ﴿وأوتوا﴾ is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «الكتاب» is a second direct object; «من قبلكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أوتوا»; «الكفار» is conjoined to «الذين أوتوا»; and «أولياء» is the second direct object of «تتخذوا».
﴿واتقوا الله إن كنتم مؤمنين﴾: The wāw is a conjunction. «اتقوا الله» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its direct object. «إن» is conditional; «كنتم» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is its noun, and «مؤمنين» is the khabar (predicate) of «كنتم». The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. «فاتقوا الله» ("then fear Allah").

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿وإذا ناديتم إلى الصلاة اتخذوها هزوا ولعبا﴾: The wāw is a conjunction joining to the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», which occurs as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «إذا» is an adverb of future time comprising the sense of condition; the clause «ناديتم» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «إلى الصلاة» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «ناديتم»; the clause «اتخذوا» has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿ها﴾ is the first direct object, «هزوًا» is the second direct object, and «لعبًا» is conjoined to it.
﴿ذلك بأنهم قوم لا يعقلون﴾: The demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject). The bāʾ is a preposition; «أن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the hāʾ is its noun, and «قوم» is its khabar (predicate); «أن» with its noun is interpreted as a maṣdar, genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of ﴿ذلك﴾. «لا» is negating, «يعقلون» is a nominative imperfect verb and the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم».

muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا أوفوا بالعقود﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (يا) is a vocative particle; (أي) is the one addressed (munādā), a specified indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of accusative; (ها) is for alerting (tanbīh); (الذين) is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; (آمنوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause (آمنوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position; (أوفوا) is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; and (بالعقود) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أوفوا).
﴿أحلت لكم بهيمة الأنعام﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. (أحلت) is a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named); (لكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (أحلت); (بهيمة) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and (الأنعام) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إلا ما يتلى عليكم غير محلي الصيد وأنتم حرم﴾: (إلا) is a particle of exception; (ما) is a disconnected excepted (mustathnā munqaṭiʿ); the clause (يتلى عليكم) is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; (غير) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of ﴿لكم﴾; (محلي) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الصيد) is muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause ﴿وأنتم حرم﴾, made up of a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), is a ḥāl from ﴿محلي الصيد﴾, i.e. "We have made lawful for you some of the livestock while you refrain from hunting, being in the state of iḥrām."
﴿إن الله يحكم ما يريد﴾: the clause gives the reason for the ruling. (إن) is an abrogating particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); the clause (يحكم) is its khabar; and (ما) is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun) or a relative, and it is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "He rules by His will", or "by that which He wills".

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: (يا) is a vocative particle; (أي) is the one addressed (munādā), a specified indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of accusative; (ها) is for alerting (tanbīh); (الذين) is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; (آمنوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause (آمنوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position.
﴿لا تحلوا شعائر الله﴾: (لا) is prohibitive; (تحلوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by it; the wāw is the fāʿil; and (شعائر الله) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ولا الشهر الحرام ولا الهدي ولا القلائد ولا آمين البيت الحرام﴾: ﴿ولا الشهر الحرام﴾ is conjoined to (شعائر); (الحرام) is a naʿt of (الشهر); what follows it is likewise conjoined to it; (ولا آمّين) is a naʿt of an omitted qualified noun, i.e. "and do not violate a people heading for…"; and (البيت) is the object of (آمّين), because it is an active participle.
﴿يبتغون فضلا من ربهم ورضوانا﴾: the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in ﴿آمِّين﴾, i.e. "the ones heading [there] being seekers of bounty"; (فضلًا) is a mafʿūl bihi; (من ربهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يبتغون), or to an omitted naʿt of ﴿فضلًا﴾; and (رضوانًا) is conjoined to it.
﴿وإذا حللتم فاصطادوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إذا) is a future adverb containing the meaning of condition; the clause (حللتم) is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the fāʾ links the answer of (إذا); (اصطادوا) is an imperative verb; and the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿ولا يجرمنكم شنآن قوم أن صدوكم عن المسجد الحرام أن تعتدوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لا) is prohibitive; (يجرمنكم) is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa in the position of jussive by (لا); the kāf is the first object; (شنآن قوم) is the fāʿil; (أن صدوكم) is an interpreted maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition, and it is the cause of the hatred (shanaʾān), attached to it; (عن المسجد) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (صدوكم); and the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن تعتدوا﴾ is the second object of (يجرمنكم).
﴿وتعاونوا على البر والتقوى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (تعاونوا) is an imperative verb; the wāw is the fāʿil; (على البر) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (تعاونوا); and (التقوى) is conjoined to (البر).
﴿ولا تعاونوا على الإثم والعدوان﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لا) is prohibitive; (تعاونوا) is an imperfect verb from which one of the two tāʾs has been dropped, jussive by (لا), i.e. "لا تتعاونوا"; (على الإثم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to it; and (العدوان) is conjoined to it.
﴿واتقوا الله إن الله شديد العقاب﴾: likewise conjoined. (إن) is an abrogating particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); ﴿شديد العقاب﴾ is its khabar (predicate); and the clause of (إن), its noun and its khabar has no grammatical position, because it gives the reason (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿حرمت عليكم الميتة والدم ولحم الخنزير﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (حرمت) is a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named); (عليكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (حرمت); (الميتة) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and (الدم) and (لحم الخنزير) are conjoined to (الميتة).
﴿وما أهل لغير الله به﴾: likewise conjoined. (ما) is a relative noun; (أهل) is a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil is ﴿هو﴾; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; (لغير الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (أهل); and (به) is a preposition and its genitive noun also attached to (أهلّ).
﴿والمنخنقة والموقوذة والمتردية والنطيحة وما أكل السبع﴾: all of them are conjoined, falling under the ruling of the forbidden things.
﴿إلا ما ذكيتم﴾: (إلا) is a particle of exception; (ما) is a relative noun, a connected excepted (mustathnā muttaṣil), accusative (manṣūb); the clause (ذكيتم) is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause of exception is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وما ذبح على النصب﴾: the clause is conjoined to the forbidden things.
﴿وأن تستقسموا بالأزلام﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is likewise conjoined, i.e. "and seeking division by divining arrows is forbidden to you".
﴿ذلكم فسق﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿اليوم يئس الذين كفروا من دينكم﴾: (اليوم) is an adverb of time attached to (يئس); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (الذين) is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent); the clause (كفروا) is the ṣila of (الذين), with no grammatical position; and (من دينكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (يئس).
﴿فلا تخشوهم واخشون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; (لا) is prohibitive; (تخشوهم) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا); (اخشوني) is an imperative verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause has no grammatical position.
﴿اليوم أكملت لكم دينكم﴾: (اليوم) is an adverb of time attached to (أكملت); (لكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun also attached to it; (دينكم) is the mafʿūl bihi of (أكملت); and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأتممت عليكم نعمتي﴾: conjoined to what precedes; (عليكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (أتممت); and (نعمتي) is the mafʿūl bihi of (أتممت).
﴿ورضيت لكم الإسلام دينا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (رضيت) is a verb and its fāʿil; (لكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; (دينًا) is a mafʿūl bihi, or a tamyīz (specification), or a ḥāl from (الإسلام); and (لكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (رضيت). [Translator's note: the source gives two different attachments for (لكم) in this line — first to an omitted ḥāl, then to (رضيت) — presumably as alternatives; it also does not parse (الإسلام).]
﴿فمن اضطر في مخمصة﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; (من) is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, and it is a mubtadaʾ; (اضطر) is a passive past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the nāʾib fāʿil is ﴿هو﴾, referring back to ﴿من﴾; and (في مخمصة) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (اضطر).
﴿غير متجانف لإثم فإن الله غفور رحيم﴾: (غير متجانف) is accusative as a ḥāl; (لإثم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (متجانف); the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (إن) is an abrogating particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); (غفور رحيم) are its two predicates; the clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of ﴿مَن﴾; and the clause ﴿فمن اضطر في مخمصة...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿يسألونك ماذا أحل لهم﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. (يسألونك) is an imperfect verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿ماذا﴾ is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause (أحل لهم) is its khabar (predicate); or ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿أحل لهم﴾ is its khabar; or ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ, and (ذا) is a relative noun, the khabar; and the interrogative clause is in the place of the second object of (يسألونك).
﴿قل أحل لكم الطيبات﴾: the clause ﴿قل...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the clause (أحل لكم الطيبات) is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); (لكم) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أحل); and (الطيبات) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿وما علمتم من الجوارح مكلبين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ما) is a relative noun conjoined to (الطيبات); the clause (علمتم) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; (من الجوارح) is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun, namely ﴿ما﴾, or from the omitted pronoun referring back to the relative noun, i.e. "علمتموه"; and (مكلبين) is a ḥāl from (علمتم). Or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (ما) is conditional, in the position of nominative as a mubtadaʾ; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is (فكلوا).
﴿تعلمونهن مما علمكم الله﴾: the clause (تعلمونهن) is a second ḥāl, or resumptive with no grammatical position; (مما) is attached to (تعلمونهن); the clause (علمكم الله) is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the second objects of (علمتم) and (تعلمونهن) are omitted, the implied sense being: "and what you have taught to hunt for you and not for themselves, teaching them that".
﴿فكلوا مما أمسكن عليكم﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, or it links the apodosis on the second analysis; (مما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (كلوا); the clause (أمسكن) is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and (عليكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (أمسكن).
﴿واذكروا اسم الله عليه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the clause (فكلوا); the clause (فكلوا) has no grammatical position, or is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.
﴿واتقوا الله إن الله سريع الحساب﴾: conjoined to what precedes; (إن) is an abrogating particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); and ﴿سريع الحساب﴾ is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿اليوم أحل لكم الطيبات﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (اليوم) is an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أحل); (أحل) is a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named); (لكم) is attached to (أحل); and (الطيبات) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿وطعام الذين أوتوا الكتاب حل لكم وطعامكم حل لهم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. (طعام) is the mubtadaʾ (subject); (الذين) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (أوتوا) is a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil; (الكتاب) is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; (حل) is the khabar (predicate) of (طعام); (لكم) is attached to (حل); and (طعامكم حل لهم) is conjoined to what precedes.
﴿والمحصنات من المؤمنات﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or it is a conjunction; (المحصنات) is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, indicated by what precedes, i.e. "are lawful for you"; and (من المؤمنات) is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from (المحصنات).
﴿والمحصنات من الذين أوتوا الكتاب من قبلكم﴾: conjoined to what precedes; and (من قبلكم) is attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿إذا آتيتموهن أجورهن محصنين غير مسافحين ولا متخذي أخدان﴾: (إذا) is an adverb attached to the omitted ﴿حل﴾; (آتيتموهن) is a past verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a first object, and the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); (أجورهن) is the second object; (محصنين) is a ḥāl; (غير مسافحين) is a second ḥāl; and (ولا متخذي أخدان) is conjoined to (مسافحين).
﴿ومن يكفر بالإيمان فقد حبط عمله﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (من) is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, and it is a mubtadaʾ; (يكفر) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (بالإيمان) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (يكفر); the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (حبط عمله) is a verb and its fāʿil; the clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of ﴿من﴾.
﴿وهو في الآخرة من الخاسرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (هو) is a mubtadaʾ; (في الآخرة) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; and (من الخاسرين) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of ﴿هو﴾.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿قل يا أهل الكتاب﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «قل» is an imperative verb; «يا» is a vocative particle [Translator's note: the source has «حرب نداء», a typo for «حرف نداء»]; and «أهل الكتاب» is the one addressed (munādā), in a genitive construct (muḍāf).
﴿هل تنقمون منا إلا أن آمنا بالله﴾: The clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). «هل» is a particle of the interrogative of disapproval; «تنقمون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «منا» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «تنقمون»; «إلا» is a particle of restriction; and ﴿أنْ﴾ with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) that is the object of «تنقمون», i.e. «ما تكرهون منا إلا الإيمان» ("you resent nothing in us but faith"). Or the maṣdar is accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) being omitted, i.e. «لا تسخطون علينا إلا لأجل إيماننا» ("you are displeased with us only because of our faith"). «بالله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «آمنا».
﴿وما أنزل إلينا وما أنزل من قبل﴾: Conjoined to the interpreted maṣdar. The clause «أنزل» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «إلينا» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أنزل». The second ﴿ما﴾ is conjoined to the first ﴿ما﴾; the clause «أنزل» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and «من قبل» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وأن أكثركم فاسقون﴾: The wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿أن﴾ with what falls in its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar, nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar (predicate) omitted, the implied form being «وفسقكم ثابت معلوم عندكم» ("and your transgression is established and known to you"). Or the maṣdar is accusative, conjoined to ﴿أن آمنا﴾, i.e. «وما تنقمون منا إلا الجمع بين إيماننا وبين تمردكم وخروجكم عن الإيمان» ("you resent in us only the combination of our faith with your rebelliousness and departure from faith"). Or the wāw is for accompaniment and the interpreted maṣdar is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), the implied form being «وما تنقمون منا إلا الإيمان مع أن أكثركم فاسقون» ("you resent in us only faith, while most of you are transgressors"). Or the maṣdar is genitive, conjoined to ﴿الله﴾, i.e. «وما تنقمون منا إلا الإيمان بالله وبما أنزل وبأن أكثركم فاسقون» ("you resent in us only faith in Allah, in what was sent down, and in the fact that most of you are transgressors").

muyesser-irab:60-60.t:
﴿قل هل أنبئكم بشر من ذلك مثوبة عند الله﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «قل» is an imperative verb, and the interrogative clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). «هل» is an interrogative particle; «أنبئكم» is an imperfect verb in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying, and the kāf is its first object; «بشرّ» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted [word] that is the second object; «من ذلك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿شرّ﴾ because it is an elative (ism tafḍīl); «مثوبة» is a tamyīz (specification) of «شر»; and in ﴿عند الله﴾ the adverb is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿من لعنه الله وغضب عليه﴾: «من» is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); for when He said: «هل أنبئكم بشرِ من ذلك؟» ("Shall I inform you of what is worse than that?"), it is as though someone asked: «مَن ذلك؟» ("Who is that?"), and it was said: «هو من لعنه الله» ("It is the one whom Allah has cursed"). The clause made of the omitted mubtadaʾ and the khabar is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وجعل منهم القردة والخنازير وعبد الطاغوت﴾: The wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿جعل﴾ is conjoined to «لعنه الله». «منهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «القردة» is the second object; and «الخنازير» is conjoined to «القردة». «عبد» is a past verb, conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the relative noun in the verse is «مَن»], as though it were said: «ومن عبد الطاغوت» ("and whoever worshipped the الطاغوت"); the relative noun was omitted and the ṣila was put in its place.
﴿أولئك شر مكانا وأضل عن سواء السبيل﴾: The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. The demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ, «شر» is the khabar, «مكانًا» is a tamyīz, «أضل» is conjoined to «شر», and «عن سواء السبيل» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أضلّ».

muyesser-irab:61-61.t:
﴿وإذا جاءوكم قالوا آمنا﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. «إذا» is an adverb of future time comprising the sense of condition; the clause «جاءوكم» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «جاءوكم» is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «قالوا» has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, and the clause «آمنا» is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وقد دخلوا بالكفر وهم قد خرجوا به﴾: The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «قد» is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); the clause «دخلوا» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in ﴿قالوا﴾; «بالكفر» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil of «دخلوا». The second wāw is also circumstantial, and the clause is likewise in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the wāw in ﴿قالوا﴾; «به» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil of «خرجوا», i.e. «قد دخلوا كافرين وخرجوا كافرين» ("they entered as disbelievers and left as disbelievers").
﴿والله أعلم بما كانوا يكتمون﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أعلم» is the khabar (predicate); «بما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أعلم»; the clause «كانوا» has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and the clause «يكتمون» is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of «كانوا».

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿وترى كثيرا منهم يسارعون في الإثم والعدوان وأكلهم السحت﴾: The wāw is a conjunction or resumptive. «ترى» is an imperfect verb, and «كثيرًا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «منهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective); the clause «يسارعون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿كثيرًا﴾, or a naʿt of it; «في الإثم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «يسارعون»; «العدوان» is conjoined to «الإثم»; the wāw is a conjunction, and «أكلهم» is conjoined to «الإثم والعدوان»; and «السحت» is the direct object of the maṣdar (verbal noun), namely ﴿أكل﴾. The clause ﴿وترى كثيرا منهم...﴾ is conjoined to ﴿وإذا جاءوكم...﴾, or is resumptive; on either view it has no grammatical position.
﴿لبئس ما كانوا يعملون﴾: The lām is the answer to an omitted oath. «بئس» is a rigid (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); «ما» is a complete indefinite in the position of the accusative as a tamyīz (specification), or it is a relative noun and so is the fāʿil. The clause ﴿كانوا﴾ has no grammatical position on either view, and the clause «يعملون» is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of «كان».

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿لولا ينهاهم الربانيون والأحبار عن قولهم الإثم وأكلهم السحت﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ) with the sense of «هلّا» ("why not"); «ينهاهم الربانيون» is an imperfect verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil (agent); «الأحبار» is conjoined to His word ﴿الربانيون﴾; ﴿عن قولهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «ينهاهم»; «الإثم» is the direct object of ﴿قول﴾; «أكلهم» is conjoined to «قولهم»; and «السحت» is the direct object of «أكل».
﴿لبئس ما كانوا يصنعون﴾: The lām is the answer to an omitted oath. «بئس» is a rigid (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); «ما» is a complete indefinite in the position of the accusative as a tamyīz (specification), or it is a relative noun and so is the fāʿil. The clause «كانوا» has no grammatical position on either view, and the clause «يصنعون» is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of «كان».

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿وقالت اليهود يد الله مغلولة﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. «قالت اليهود» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «يد الله» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and «مغلولة» is the khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿غلت أيديهم ولعنوا بما قالوا﴾: «غلت»: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive). «أيديهم»: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «لعنوا»: conjoined to «غلت أيديهم». «بما»: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿لعنوا﴾. «قالوا»: a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. The clause ﴿قالوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The clause ﴿غلت أيديهم﴾ is parenthetical, as an imprecation against them, with no grammatical position.
﴿بل يداه مبسوطتان ينفق كيف يشاء﴾: «بل» is a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction; «يداه» is a mubtadaʾ and «مبسوطتان» is the khabar, and the clause is conjoined to the clause «يد الله مغلولة». The clause «ينفق» is resumptive with no grammatical position, the meaning being: His spending is according to what His will requires, for He is the One who withholds and the One who extends. It is also said that it is a second khabar of ﴿يداه﴾. «كيف» here is conditional, in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وليزيدن كثيرا منهم ما أنزل إليك من ربك طغيانا وكفرا﴾: The wāw is the wāw of the omitted oath; the omitted oath[-object] is genitive by the wāw, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb whose implied form is «أقسم» ("I swear"). The lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath; «يزيدن» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath. «كثيرًا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «منهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective); «ما» is a relative noun, the fāʿil of «يزيدن»; the clause «أنزل» is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; «من ربك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl; «طغيانًا» is a tamyīz (specification), or a second direct object of «يزيدن»; and «كفرًا» is conjoined to ﴿طغيانًا﴾.
﴿وألقينا بينهم العداوة والبغضاء إلى يوم القيامة﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. «ألقينا» is a verb and its fāʿil; «بينهم» is an adverb attached to «ألقينا»; «العداوة» is a direct object and «البغضاء» is conjoined to «العداوة»; and «إلى يوم القيامة» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿كلما أوقدوا نارا للحرب أطفأها الله﴾: ﴿كلما﴾: ﴿كلَّ﴾ stands in for an adverb of time, attached to ﴿أطفأها﴾, and comprises the sense of condition; ﴿ما﴾ is temporal and maṣdar-forming. The clause ﴿أوقدوا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the particle relative ﴿ما﴾, and ﴿ما﴾ with what it governs is interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar), genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the implied form being «كلَّ إيقاد» ("every kindling"); this is on the supposition of an omitted muḍāf, i.e. «كلَّ وقتِ إيقادِ نار» ("every time of kindling a fire"). Or ﴿ما﴾ is a qualified indefinite meaning ﴿وقت﴾ ("time"), the resumptive pronoun being omitted, the implied form being «كلَّ وقتٍ أوقدوا فيه نارًا» ("every time in which they kindled a fire"); the clause ﴿أوقدوا﴾ is then in the position of the genitive as a naʿt of ﴿ما﴾. ﴿أوقدوا﴾ is a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; «نارًا» is a direct object; «للحرب» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أوقدوا»; and the clause ﴿أطفأها الله﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. The whole clause is also resumptive.
﴿ويسعون في الأرض فسادا﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. «يسعون» is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; «في الأرض» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «يسعون»; «فسادًا» stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of maṣdar for a verb of its meaning; or it is a ḥāl meaning «مفسدين» ("causing corruption"); or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. «يسعون لأجل الفساد» ("they strive for the sake of corruption").
﴿والله لا يحب المفسدين﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, the clause «لا يحب» is the khabar, and «المفسدين» is the direct object.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t:
﴿ولو أن أهل الكتاب آمنوا واتقوا﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. «لو» is a non-jussive conditional particle; «أن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), «أهل الكتاب» is its noun, and the clause «آمنوا» is its khabar (predicate); «أن» with its noun and khabar is in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb whose implied form is «ثبت» ("it were established"); and the clause ﴿اتقوا﴾ is conjoined to the clause «آمنوا».
﴿لكفرنا عنهم سيئاتهم ولأدخلناهم جنات النعيم﴾: The lām occurs in the apodosis of ﴿لو﴾. «كفرنا» is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿عنهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿كفرنا﴾, and «سيئاتهم» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿ولأدخلناهم﴾ is conjoined to the clause «لكفرنا». «جنات» is a second direct object by extension of usage (ʿalā al-saʿa), or it is accusative by removal of the preposition, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to «أدخلناهم»; and «النعيم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:66-66.t:
﴿ولو أنهم أقاموا التوراة والإنجيل وما أنزل إليهم من ربهم﴾: The wāw is resumptive. «لو» is a non-jussive conditional particle; «أن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿أقاموا التوراة والإنجيل﴾ is its khabar (predicate); «أن» with its noun and khabar is in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb whose implied form is «ثبت» ("it were established"). «ما» is conjoined to «التوراة والإنجيل»; the clause «أنزل» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «إليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أنزل»; and ﴿من ربهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿لأكلوا من فوقهم ومن تحت أرجلهم﴾: The lām occurs in the apodosis of «لو»; the clause «أكلوا» has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; «من فوقهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أكلوا»; and «من تحت أرجلهم» is conjoined to ﴿من فوقهم﴾. The clause ﴿ولو أنهم أقاموا...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿منهم أمة مقتصدة وكثير منهم ساء ما يعملون﴾: The clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. «منهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar placed first; «أمة» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later; and «مقتصدة» is a naʿt (adjective). ﴿كثير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «كثير» is a mubtadaʾ; it was permissible to begin with it because it is qualified by the preposition and its genitive noun. The clause «ساء ما يعملون» is the khabar of ﴿كثير﴾, and the clause «يعملون» is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:67-67.t:
﴿يا أيها الرسول﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle for one at middle distance; «أيّ» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; «ها» is for drawing attention; and «الرسول» is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾.
﴿بلغ ما أنزل إليك من ربك﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «بلغ» is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is «أنت» ("you"); «ما» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «أنزل» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «إليك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أنزل»; and «من ربك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وإن لم تفعل فما بلغت رسالته﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. «إن» is conditional; «لم تفعل» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ links the apodosis; «ما» is negating; the clause «بلغت» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and «رسالته» is a direct object.
﴿والله يعصمك من الناس﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause «يعصمك» is its khabar (predicate), and «من الناس» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «يعصمك».
﴿إن الله لا يهدي القوم الكافرين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the Divine Name is its noun; the clause ﴿لا يهدي﴾ is its khabar; «القوم» is a direct object; and «الكافرين» is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:68-68.t:
﴿قل يا أهل الكتاب لستم على شيء﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «قل» is an imperative verb; «يا أهل الكتاب» is the one addressed (munādā), in a genitive construct (muḍāf); «لستم» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun, and «على شيء» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to its omitted khabar (predicate).
﴿حتى تقيموا التوراة والإنجيل وما أنزل إليكم من ربكم﴾: «حتى» is a particle of limit and a preposition; «تقيموا» is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by a concealed «أن» after «حتى», and the preposition and its genitive noun [Translator's note: i.e. «حتى» with the interpreted maṣdar] are attached to ﴿لستم﴾. «التوراة» is the object of «تقيموا», and an omitted muḍāf must be supposed, i.e. their rulings and the lofty ideals they contain [Translator's note: the source reads «من مثل عليا»].
﴿وليزيدن كثيرا منهم ما أنزل إليك من ربك طغيانا وكفرا﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. The lām is the answer to an omitted oath; «يزيدن» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath. «كثيرًا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «منهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كثيرًا﴾; «ما» is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent) of «يزيدن»; «من ربك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «طغيانًا» is a second direct object or a tamyīz (specification); and «كفرًا» is conjoined to ﴿طغيانًا﴾.
﴿فلا تأس على القوم الكافرين﴾: The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that presupposes an implied condition), i.e. «إذا علمت هذا فلا تأس» ("since you know this, do not grieve"). «لا» is prohibitive, and «تأس» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا», the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; «على القوم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «تأس»; and «الكافرين» is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:69-69.t:
﴿إن الذين آمنوا والذين هادوا﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and «الذين» is its noun; the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and «الذين هادوا» is conjoined to «الذين آمنوا».
﴿والصابئون والنصارى من آمن بالله واليوم الآخر وعمل صالحا﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. «الصابئون» is nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar (predicate) omitted, and it is intended to come after what is in ﴿إنّ﴾ — its noun and its khabar — as though it were said: «إن الذين آمنوا والذين هادوا والنصارى حكمهم كذا، والصابئون كذلك» ("Those who believed, those who were Jews and the Christians — their ruling is such-and-such, and the Sabians likewise"). The conjunction is of the type of conjoining clauses: «الصابئون» with its omitted khabar is a clause conjoined to the clause of His words ﴿إن الذين آمنوا﴾, and it has no grammatical position, just as the clause it is conjoined to has no position. «النصارى» is conjoined to «الذين»; «من» is a relative noun, a badal (substitute) from «الذين»; the clause «آمن بالله» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «اليوم الآخر» is conjoined to ﴿الله﴾; «عمل» is conjoined to «آمن»; and «صالحًا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿عمل﴾, or it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) because it is a qualifier of the maṣdar, i.e. «عمل عملًا صالحًا» ("did a righteous deed").
﴿فلا خوف عليهم﴾: The clause is the khabar of «إن», and the fāʾ was brought in because of the flavour of condition in the relative noun. «لا» is negating, and «خوف» is a mubtadaʾ; it was permissible to begin with it, though indefinite, because the negation precedes it. «عليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar.
﴿ولا هم يحزنون﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; «لا»: negating; «هم»: mubtadaʾ. «يحزنون»: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿يحزنون﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿هم﴾.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t:
﴿لقد أخذنا ميثاق بني إسرائيل﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. The lām is the answer to an omitted oath; «قد» is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); «أخذنا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «ميثاق» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and «بني إسرائيل» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وأرسلنا إليهم رسلا﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; «أرسلنا» is a verb and its fāʿil; «إليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أرسلنا»; and «رسلًا» is a direct object.
﴿كلما جاءهم رسول بما لا تهوى أنفسهم فريقا كذبوا وفريقا يقتلون﴾: ﴿كلَّ﴾ stands in for an adverb of time containing the sense of condition, attached to both verbs ﴿كذبوا﴾ and ﴿يقتلون﴾ by way of contention (tanāzuʿ), or attached to an omitted [verb] indicated by His words ﴿فريقا كذبوا وفريقا يقتلون﴾. ﴿ما﴾ is temporal and maṣdar-forming; the clause ﴿جاءهم﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative ﴿ما﴾; and ﴿ما﴾ with what it governs is interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar), genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the implied form being «كلَّ مجيء» ("every coming"); this is on the supposition of an omitted muḍāf, i.e. «كلَّ وقتِ مجيءِ رسولٍ» ("every time of a messenger's coming"). Or ﴿ما﴾ is a qualified indefinite meaning ﴿وقت﴾ ("time"), the resumptive pronoun being omitted, the implied form being «كلَّ وقتٍ جاءهم فيه رسول» ("every time in which a messenger came to them"); the clause ﴿جاءهم﴾ is then in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ما﴾. ﴿جاءهم﴾ is a verb and a direct object placed first, and ﴿رسول﴾ is the fāʿil placed later; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «جاءهم», and ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun; the clause ﴿لا تهوى أنفسهم﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿فريقًا﴾ is an object placed before «كذبوا»; ﴿كذبوا﴾ is a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the second ﴿فريقًا﴾ is an object placed before «يقتلون»; ﴿يقتلون﴾ is an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿فريقا كذبوا﴾ has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: (يا) is a vocative particle; (أي) is the one addressed (munādā), a specified indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of accusative; (ها) is for alerting (tanbīh); (الذين) is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; (آمنوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause (آمنوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position.
﴿إذا قمتم إلى الصلاة فاغسلوا وجوهكم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (إذا) is a future adverb containing the meaning of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) His word (فاغسلوا); the clause (قمتم) is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); (إلى الصلاة) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (قمتم); the fāʾ is linking; the clause (اغسلوا) has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a condition that does not make the verb jussive; and (وجوهكم) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وأيديكم إلى المرافق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿أيديكم﴾ is conjoined to (وجوهكم); and ﴿إلى المرافق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿أيديكم﴾.
﴿وامسحوا برءوسكم﴾: conjoined to what precedes. The bāʾ is connective (ṣila), or partitive (li-l-tabʿīḍ), or for contact (li-l-ilṣāq); and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (امسحوا).
﴿وأرجلكم إلى الكعبين﴾: ﴿وأرجلكم﴾ is conjoined to (وجوهكم), i.e. "and wash your feet up to the ankles".
﴿وإن كنتم جنبا فاطهروا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إن) is conditional; ﴿كنتم﴾ is a defective, abrogating past verb; the tāʾ is its noun (ism), and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (جنبًا) is the khabar (predicate) of (كنتم); and the clause (اطهروا) is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿وإن كنتم مرضى أو على سفر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إن) is conditional; (كنتم) is the protasis; the tāʾ is its noun; and (مرضى) is its khabar.
﴿أو جاء أحد منكم من الغائط﴾: (أو) is a conjunction; (على سفر) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted second khabar of (كنتم); (جاء) is conjoined to (كنتم); (أحد) is the fāʿil of (جاء); (منكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of (أحد); and (من الغائط) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (جاء). [Translator's note: the parsing of (على سفر) belongs to the previous phrase but is placed here in the source.]
﴿أو لامستم النساء﴾: (أو) is a conjunction, and (لامستم النساء) is conjoined to what precedes.
﴿فلم تجدوا ماء فتيمموا صعيدا طيبا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (لم تجدوا) is likewise conjoined; (ماء) is a mafʿūl bihi; the fāʾ links the apodosis; the clause (فتيمموا صعيدًا) is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; and (طيبًا) is a naʿt.
﴿فامسحوا بوجوهكم وأيديكم منه﴾: conjoined to what precedes; and (منه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (امسحوا).
﴿ما يريد الله ليجعل عليكم من حرج﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. (ما) is negating; (يريد الله) is a verb and its fāʿil; in ﴿ليجعل﴾ the lām is causal (li-l-taʿlīl); (يجعل) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (أن) after the causal lām; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied (أن) and the imperfect verb is genitive by the lām, and the lām and its genitive are attached to ﴿يريد﴾; and the object of (يريد) is omitted, the implied form being: "He does not want that, in order to place any hardship upon you". Or the lām in ﴿ليجعل﴾ is connective (ṣila), and (يجعل) is an imperfect verb, accusative by a maṣdar-forming (أن) assumed after the lām, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن يجعل﴾ is the object of (يريد), the implied form being: "Allah does not want to place any hardship upon you", i.e. "Allah does not want the placing of hardship upon you". The verb jaʿala is either in the sense of bringing into existence and creating, in which case it takes one object, and the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عليكم﴾ are attached to it or to an omitted ḥāl from ﴿حرج﴾; (من) is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and (حرج) is genitive in form and accusative in position, as the object of (يجعل). Or jaʿala is in the sense of making [something into something] (taṣyīr), in which case it takes two objects, and the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عليكم﴾ are attached to an omitted element which is the second object, and ﴿من حرج﴾ is the first object.
﴿ولكن يريد ليطهركم وليتم نعمته عليكم لعلكم تشكرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لكن) is a particle of rectification (istidrāk), and it is inoperative because it is lightened; (يريد) is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is ﴿هو﴾; in ﴿ليطهركم﴾ the lām is causal; (يطهركم) is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (أن) after the causal lām; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو", referring to Allah the Exalted; the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi, and the mīm is the sign of the plural; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the imperfect verb is genitive by the causal lām, and the lām and its genitive are attached to ﴿يريد﴾; and the object of (يريد) is omitted. Or the lām in ﴿ليطهركم﴾ is connective, and (يطهركم) is an imperfect verb, accusative by a maṣdar-forming (أن) assumed after the lām, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن يطهركم﴾ is the object of (يريد), the implied form being: "but He wants to purify you", i.e. "He wants your purification". ﴿وليتم نعمته عليكم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ليطهركم﴾; (لعل) is an abrogating particle; the kāf is the noun (ism) of (لعل); the clause ﴿تشكرون﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of (لعل); and the clause ﴿لعلكم تشكرون﴾ gives the reason (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿واذكروا نعمة الله عليكم وميثاقه الذي واثقكم به﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the speech after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. (اذكروا نعمة الله) is an imperative verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (عليكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نعمة﴾ if it is taken as a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "remember His bestowing [favour] upon you", or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿نعمة﴾ if it is taken as a noun, i.e. "remember His favour as being upon you"; (ميثاقه) is conjoined to (نعمة الله); (الذي) is a naʿt (adjective) of (ميثاق); and the clause (واثقكم به) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿إذ قلتم سمعنا وأطعنا﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb for past time, attached to (واثقكم); the clause (قلتم) is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the clause (سمعنا) is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause (وأطعنا) is conjoined to it.
﴿واتقوا الله إن الله عليم بذات الصدور﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (اتقوا الله) is an imperative verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; and the clause of (إن) and what falls within its scope gives the reason (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا كونوا قوامين لله شهداء بالقسط﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (يا) is a vocative particle; (أي) is the one addressed (munādā), a specified indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of accusative; (ها) is for alerting (tanbīh); (الذين) is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; (آمنوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause (آمنوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position; (كونوا) is a defective imperative verb; the wāw is its noun (ism); (قوامين) is its khabar (predicate); (لله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قوامين); (شهداء) is a second khabar of (كونوا); and (بالقسط) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (شهداء).
﴿ولا يجرمنكم شنآن قوم على ألا تعدلوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لا) is prohibitive; (يجرمنكم) is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa in the position of jussive by (لا); the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿شنآن قوم﴾ is the fāʿil; (على) is a preposition; ﴿أن﴾ and what falls within its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar, genitive by (على); and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (يجرمنكم).
﴿اعدلوا هو أقرب للتقوى﴾: the clause ﴿اعدلوا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿هو﴾ is a detached pronoun, the mubtadaʾ (subject), referring back to the maṣdar understood from His word ﴿اعدلوا﴾; (أقرب) is the khabar; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; and (للتقوى) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (أقرب).
﴿واتقوا الله إن الله خبير بما تعملون﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (اتقوا الله) is an imperative verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause of (إن) and what falls within its scope gives the reason (taʿlīliyya); (بما تعملون) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿خبير﴾; the clause (تعملون) has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; and (خبير) is the khabar of (إن).

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿وعد الله الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (وعد الله) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (الذين) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (آمنوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and (عملوا الصالحات) is conjoined to the ṣila.
﴿لهم مغفرة﴾: (لهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (مغفرة) is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause ﴿لهم مغفرة﴾ explains the second object, as the cause explains what it causes, or it is resumptive; on both views it has no grammatical position. Or the clause is accusative by an omitted verb of saying, as if it were said: "He promised them and said: they will have forgiveness"; or it is a clause in the position of accusative as the second object of His word ﴿وعد﴾, in the sense of ﴿وعدهم أن لهم مغفرة﴾ ("He promised them that they will have forgiveness") or ﴿وعدهم مغفرة﴾ ("He promised them forgiveness"), so the clause has taken the place of a single word and made it unnecessary.
﴿وأجر عظيم﴾: conjoined to ﴿مغفرة﴾; and (عظيم) is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أجر﴾.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t: ﴿والذين كفروا وكذبوا بآياتنا أولئك أصحاب الجحيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position; the clause (كذبوا بآياتنا) is conjoined to the ṣila, with no grammatical position; (أولئك) is a second mubtadaʾ (subject); (أصحاب الجحيم) is the khabar (predicate) of (أولئك); the nominal clause is the khabar of (الذين); and the clause ﴿والذين كفروا...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source does not state the function of (الذين) explicitly; it is implied to be the first mubtadaʾ.]

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (يا) is a vocative particle; (أي) is the one addressed (munādā), a specified indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of accusative; (ها) is for alerting (tanbīh); (الذين) is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; (آمنوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause (آمنوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position.
﴿اذكروا نعمة الله عليكم﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿اذكروا نعمة الله﴾ is an imperative verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (عليكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نعمة﴾ if it is taken as a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "remember His bestowing [favour] upon you", or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿نعمة﴾ if it is taken as a noun, i.e. "remember His favour as being upon you".
﴿إذ هم قوم أن يبسطوا إليكم أيديهم﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of ﴿نعمة الله﴾, attached to it on the assumption that ﴿نعمة﴾ is a maṣdar; or it is a noun, indeclinable on sukūn in the position of accusative as a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) for ﴿نعمة الله﴾; the clause ﴿همَّ قوم﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن يبسطوا﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿همَّ﴾; ﴿إليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يبسطوا﴾; and (أيديهم) is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فكف أيديهم عنكم﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿واتقوا الله وعلى الله فليتوكل المؤمنون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (اتقوا الله) is a verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿واتقوا الله﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (على الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (يتوكل); the fāʾ is resumptive; the lām is the lām of command; (يتوكل) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; (المؤمنون) is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿فليتوكل المؤمنون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿ولقد أخذ الله ميثاق بني إسرائيل﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. The lām is the answer to an omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (أخذ الله) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (ميثاق) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (بني إسرائيل) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وبعثنا منهم اثني عشر نقيبا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (بعثنا) is conjoined to (أخذ); (منهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نقيبًا﴾, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿اثني عشر﴾; (اثني عشر) is the mafʿūl bihi of (بعثنا); and (نقيبًا) is a tamyīz (specification).
﴿وقال الله إني معكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (قال الله) is a verb and its fāʿil; in (إني), (إن) is an abrogating particle and the yāʾ is its noun (ism); (معكم) is an adverb attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); and ﴿إن﴾ and what falls within its scope are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿لئن أقمتم الصلاة وآتيتم الزكاة﴾: the lām prepares for (muwaṭṭiʾa) the omitted oath; (إن) is conditional; (أقمتم) is a verb and its fāʿil, and it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (الصلاة) is a mafʿūl bihi; (آتيتم الزكاة) is conjoined to (أقمتم الصلاة); and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وآمنتم برسلي وعزرتموهم وأقرضتم الله قرضا حسنا﴾: conjoined to what precedes. (برسلي) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (آمنتم); (عزرتموهم) is likewise conjoined, and it is a verb and its fāʿil, the wāw being for lengthening the ḍamma, and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi; (أقرضتم الله) is a verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; (قرضًا) stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar); and (حسنًا) is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿لأكفرن عنكم سيئاتكم ولأدخلنكم جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath that precedes it. (عنكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (أكفرنَّ); (سيئاتكم) is a mafʿūl bihi; (لأدخلنكم) is conjoined to ﴿لأكفرن﴾; (جنات) is a second object by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa), or accusative by removal of the preposition; and the clause (تجري من تحتها الأنهار) is a naʿt of (جنات).
﴿فمن كفر بعد ذلك منكم فقد ضل سواء السبيل﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. (من) is conditional, a mubtadaʾ (subject); (كفر) is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis; (بعد ذلك) is an adverb attached to (كفر); (منكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; in ﴿فقد﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, and the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of ﴿من﴾; and (سواء السبيل) is the object of (ضل).

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿فبما نقضهم ميثاقهم لعناهم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. The bāʾ is a preposition; (ما) is a connective (ṣila) for emphasising the speech; (نقضهم) is genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) (لعناهم); (ميثاقهم) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the maṣdar (verbal noun), namely "the breaking"; and (لعناهم) is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وجعلنا قلوبهم قاسية﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (جعلنا) is conjoined to (لعناهم); (قلوبهم) is the first object; and (قاسية) is the second object.
﴿يحرفون الكلم عن مواضعه﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (الكلم) is the object of (يحرفون); and (عن مواضعه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (يحرفون).
﴿ونسوا حظا مما ذكروا به﴾: conjoined to what precedes. (نسوا حظًّا) is a verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; (مما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿حظًّا﴾; and the clause (ذكروا به) has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿ولا تزال تطلع على خائنة منهم إلا قليلا منهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لا تزال) is a defective imperfect verb, and its noun (ism) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت"; the clause (تطلع) is the khabar (predicate) of (لا تزال); (على خائنة) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (تطلع); (منهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of (خائنة); (إلا) is a particle of exception; (قليلًا) is excepted from the genitive pronoun in ﴿منهم﴾; and (منهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿قليلًا﴾.
﴿فاعف عنهم واصفح﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, i.e. "if you know this, then pardon whoever comes to you declaring his repentance and his joining under the banner of the upright religion". (اعف) is an imperative verb; (عنهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿اعف﴾; and (اصفح) is conjoined to (فاعف).
﴿إن الله يحب المحسنين﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause (يحب المحسنين) is the khabar of (إن); and the clause of (إن) and what falls within its scope gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿ومن الذين قالوا إنا نصارى أخذنا ميثاقهم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أخذنا); the clause (قالوا) has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; (إن) is an abrogating particle; ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); (نصارى) is its khabar (predicate); the clause (أخذنا) is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (ميثاقهم) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause (إنا نصارى) is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿فنسوا حظا مما ذكروا به﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (نسوا) is conjoined to (أخذنا); the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (حظًّا) is a mafʿūl bihi; (مما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿حظًّا﴾; the clause (ذكروا) is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; (به) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (ذكروا); and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿فأغرينا بينهم العداوة والبغضاء إلى يوم القيامة﴾: conjoined to what precedes. (أغرينا) is a verb and its fāʿil; the adverb is attached to (أغرينا); (العداوة) is a mafʿūl bihi; and (إلى يوم القيامة) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "extending to the Day of Resurrection".
﴿وسوف ينبئهم الله بما كانوا يصنعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (سوف) is a particle of future; (ينبئهم) is a verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; (بما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (ينبئهم); the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause (يصنعون) is the khabar of (كان).

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿يا أهل الكتاب قد جاءكم رسولنا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (يا) is a vocative particle for one at a middle distance; (أهل الكتاب) is a muḍāf munādā (one addressed in a genitive construct), accusative (manṣūb); (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (جاءكم) is a past verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (رسولنا) is a postponed fāʿil (agent).
﴿يبين لكم كثيرا مما كنتم تخفون من الكتاب﴾: the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿رسولنا﴾.
