(لكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يبيّن﴾; (كثيرًا) is a mafʿūl bihi; (مما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كثيرًا﴾; (ما) is a relative noun; ﴿كنتم﴾ is a defective, abrogating past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun (ism); the clause (تخفون) is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of (كان); (من الكتاب) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl from the omitted referential pronoun; and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿ويعفو عن كثير﴾: the clause is conjoined to the ḥāl clause ﴿يبين﴾.
﴿قد جاءكم من الله نور وكتاب مبين﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. (من الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; (نور) is the fāʿil of ﴿جاءكم﴾; (كتاب) is conjoined to ﴿نور﴾; and (مبين) is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿يهدي به الله من اتبع رضوانه سبل السلام﴾: the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of (كتاب). (به) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يهدي); (الله) is the fāʿil (agent); (من) is a relative noun, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (اتبع رضوانه) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and (سبل السلام) is a second object of (يهدي) by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa), or accusative by removal of the preposition, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (يهدي).
﴿ويخرجهم من الظلمات إلى النور بإذنه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (يخرجهم) is conjoined to (يهدي); the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi; (من الظلمات) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (يخرجهم), and likewise ﴿إلى النور﴾; and (بإذنه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ويهديهم إلى صراط مستقيم﴾: conjoined to what precedes. (يهديهم) is a verb and a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿إلى صراط﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (يهديهم) as a second object; and (مستقيم) is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿لقد كفر الذين قالوا إن الله هو المسيح ابن مريم﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (كفر) is a past verb; (الذين) is its fāʿil (agent); the clause (قالوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the oath clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the clause (قد كفر) has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to the oath; (إن) is an abrogating particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); (إن), its noun and its khabar are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) conveying restriction, with no governing effect, and (المسيح) is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); or ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and (المسيح) the khabar, the clause being the khabar of (إن); and (ابن مريم) is a badal (substitute) or a naʿt (adjective).
﴿قل فمن يملك من الله شيئا﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. (قل) is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil is "أنت". ﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; (من) is a noun of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), the mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿يملك﴾ is the khabar; the clause ﴿من يملك﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if Allah wanted to destroy the people, then who could avail anything against Allah?"; and the two clauses of the condition and its apodosis are in the position of accusative as the object of the saying. (من الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿شيئا﴾, or to ﴿يملك﴾; and (شيئًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إن أراد أن يهلك المسيح ابن مريم وأمه﴾: the clause is a conditional clause explaining the previously implied condition, with no grammatical position; the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes, i.e. "then who could avail anything against Allah?". (إن) is conditional; (أراد) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (أن) and what falls within its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar, the object of (أراد); (المسيح) is a mafʿūl bihi; (ابن مريم) is a badal or a naʿt; (أمه) is conjoined to ﴿المسيح﴾; and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ومن في الأرض جميعا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (من) is a relative noun conjoined to (المسيح) and (أمه); (في الأرض) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted ṣila of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; and (جميعًا) is a ḥāl.
﴿ولله ملك السماوات والأرض وما بينهما﴾: the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl; (لله) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (ملك السماوات والأرض) is a postponed mubtadaʾ; in ﴿وما بينهما﴾ the wāw conjoins to (ملك); (ما) is a relative noun; the adverb is attached to the omitted ṣila of the relative noun; and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿يخلق ما يشاء﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله على كل شيء قدير﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ; (قدير) is its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (قدير); and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:71-71.t:
﴿وحسبوا ألا تكون فتنة﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; «حسبوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «أن» is a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle; «لا» is negating; ﴿تكون﴾ is a complete (tāmm) imperfect verb in the subjunctive by «أن»; «فتنة» is the fāʿil; and ﴿أنْ﴾ with what follows it stands in place of the two objects of «حسبوا».
﴿فعموا وصموا ثم تاب الله عليهم﴾: The fāʾ is a conjunction; «عموا» is conjoined to «حسبوا»; «صموا» is conjoined to His word ﴿فعموا﴾; «ثم» is a conjunction for sequence with delay; «تاب الله» is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined to His words ﴿فعموا وصموا﴾; and «عليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «تاب».
﴿ثم عموا وصموا كثير منهم﴾: «ثم عموا وصموا» is conjoined to what preceded; «كثير» is a badal (substitute) from the pronoun in «عموا» or «صموا»; and ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «كثير».
﴿والله بصير بما يعملون﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «بصير» is the khabar (predicate); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «بصير»; and the clause «يعملون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿لقد كفر الذين قالوا إن الله هو المسيح ابن مريم﴾: The lām is the answer to an omitted oath, and «قد» is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); the oath clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. «كفر الذين» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause has no position because it is the answer to an omitted oath. The clause «قالوا» has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», and the clause «إن الله» is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the Divine Name is its noun; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «المسيح» is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هو﴾; the nominal clause is the khabar of «إن»; «ابن» is a badal (substitute) from «المسيح»; and «مريم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وقال المسيح يا بني إسرائيل اعبدوا الله ربي وربكم﴾: The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «قال المسيح» is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in ﴿قالوا﴾. «يا بني إسرائيل» is the one addressed (munādā), in a genitive construct (muḍāf); the clause «اعبدوا الله» is in the position of the accusative as the object of al-Masīḥ's saying; ﴿ربي﴾ is a badal from ﴿الله﴾; and ﴿ربكم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ربي﴾.
﴿إنه من يشرك بالله فقد حرم الله عليه الجنة﴾: The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. «إن» is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is its noun. «من» is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; «يشرك» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «بالله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «يشرك»; the fāʾ links the apodosis; the clause «فقد حرم» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and the protasis together with its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿من﴾. The whole conditional clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of «إنّ». «حرم الله» is a verb and its fāʿil; «عليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «حرّم»; and «الجنة» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ومأواه النار وما للظالمين من أنصار﴾: The wāw is resumptive. «مأواه» is a khabar placed first and «النار» is a mubtadaʾ placed later; or «مأواه» is the mubtadaʾ and «النار» is the khabar. The clause ﴿ومأواه النار﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position. The wāw is a conjunction; «ما» is negating; «للظالمين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar placed first; «من» is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; and «أنصار» is genitive in form and nominative in position, because it is a mubtadaʾ placed later.

muyesser-irab:73-73.t:
﴿لقد كفر الذين قالوا إن الله ثالث ثلاثة﴾: The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. The lām is the answer to an omitted oath; the clause ﴿كفر الذين قالوا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath; and the clause «قالوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Divine Name is its noun, and «ثالث ثلاثة» is its khabar (predicate); the clause headed by «أن» [Translator's note: so in the source; the particle is «إنّ»] is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وما من إله إلا إله واحد﴾: The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «ما» is negating; «من» is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; «إله» is genitive in form and nominative in position as mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar omitted, i.e. «موجود» ("existing"); [the second] «إله» is a badal (substitute) from the pronoun in it [i.e. in the omitted khabar]; and «إلا» is a particle of restriction.
﴿وإن لم ينتهوا عما يقولون﴾: The wāw is resumptive; «إن» is conditional; «لم ينتهوا» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «عما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «ينتهوا»; and the clause «يقولون» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿ليمسن الذين كفروا منهم عذاب أليم﴾: The lām occurs in the answer to an oath implied before the conditional particle. «يمسّن» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; «الذين» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «كفروا» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «منهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «عذاب» is the fāʿil (agent); and «أليم» is a naʿt (adjective). The clause ﴿ليمسَّن...﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the implied oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath. The clause ﴿وإن لم ينتهوا...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:74-74.t: ﴿أفلا يتوبون إلى الله ويستغفرونه والله غفور رحيم﴾: The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. The hamza is for the interrogative of wonder and disapproval, and the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something implied, i.e. «ألا ينتهون فلا يتوبون» ("Will they not desist, and so not repent?"). «إلى الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «يتوبون»; «يستغفرونه» is conjoined to «يتوبون»; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «غفور رحيم» are two khabars (predicates) of it; and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:75-75.t:
﴿ما المسيح ابن مريم إلا رسول قد خلت من قبله الرسل﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «ما» is negating, and it does not work as «ليس» works because the negation is broken by «إلا». «المسيح» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «ابن مريم» is a badal (substitute) or a naʿt (adjective); «إلا» is a particle of restriction; «رسول» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the clause «قد خلت» is a naʿt; «من قبله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «خلت», i.e. passed away and perished; and «الرسول» [Translator's note: so in the source; the word in the verse is «الرسل»] is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿وأمه صديقة كانا يأكلان الطعام﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; «أمه» is a mubtadaʾ and «صديقة» is the khabar. The clause ﴿كانا يأكلان الطعام﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position. The alif of the dual is the noun of «كان», the clause «يأكلان» is the khabar of «كانا», and «الطعام» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿انظر كيف نبين لهم الآيات ثم انظر أنى يؤفكون﴾: The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. «كيف» is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the interrogative clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of «انظر»; ﴿كيف﴾ has suspended (ʿallaqat) ﴿انظر﴾ from governing what follows it in form. «نبين لهم الآيات» is a verb, its concealed fāʿil and a direct object. «ثم» is a conjunction for sequence and delay, and the meaning is: the clarification of these signs was a wonder, and their turning away from them and their averting themselves from reflecting on them was more wondrous still. «أنّى» is an interrogative noun meaning «كيف» ("how"), in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl; «يؤفكون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:76-76.t:
﴿قل أتعبدون من دون الله ما لا يملك لكم ضرا ولا نفعا﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «قل» is an imperative verb; the hamza is a particle of the interrogative of rebuke and wonder; and the clause «أتعبدون» is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). «من دون الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «ما» is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause «لا يملك» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; or ﴿ما﴾ is a qualified indefinite and the clause ﴿لا يملك﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective). «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «يملك»; «ضرًّا» is the direct object of «يملك»; and «لا نفعًا» is conjoined to ﴿ضرًّا﴾.
﴿والله هو السميع العليم﴾: The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the link between the ḥāl and its owner is the wāw. ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, or a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; and «السميع العليم» are two khabars (predicates) of ﴿الله﴾ or of ﴿هو﴾.

muyesser-irab:77-77.t:
﴿قل يا أهل الكتاب لا تغلوا في دينكم غير الحق﴾: The clause of saying is resumptive with no grammatical position, and what follows it is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). «لا» is prohibitive; «تغلوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا»; and «في دينكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «تغلوا». «غير»: stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a qualifier of the maṣdar, i.e. «غلوًّا غير الحق» ("an exaggeration other than the truth"); or it is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of the fāʿil (agent), namely the wāw, i.e. «مجاوزين الحق» ("exceeding the truth"); or it is accusative as a connected exception, or as a disconnected exception. «الحق»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ولا تتبعوا أهواء قوم قد ضلوا من قبل وأضلوا كثيرا﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; «لا» is prohibitive; «تتبعوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive by ﴿لا﴾; «أهواء» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «قوم» is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause «قد ضلوا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم»; «من قبل» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «ضلوا», and ﴿قبل﴾ is indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because the adverb is cut off from the iḍāfa in wording but not in meaning; «أضلوا» is conjoined to «قد ضلوا»; and «كثيرًا» is a direct object.
﴿وضلوا عن سواء السبيل﴾: Conjoined to what preceded.

muyesser-irab:78-78.t:
﴿لعن الذين كفروا من بني إسرائيل على لسان داود وعيسى ابن مريم﴾: «لُعن» is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and «الذين» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause «كفروا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «من بني إسرائيل» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «على لسان» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «لعن»; «داود» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «عيسى» is conjoined to «داود»; «ابن» is a naʿt (adjective) of «عيسى» or a badal (substitute) from it; and «مريم» is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause ﴿لُعن﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿ذلك بما عصوا وكانوا يعتدون﴾: The demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «بما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). «ما» is maṣdar-forming, ﴿عصوا﴾ is a past verb and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and ﴿ما﴾ with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar, genitive by the bāʾ, i.e. «بسبب عصيانهم» ("because of their disobedience"); or ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun and the clause ﴿عصوا﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. The clause «كانوا» is conjoined to «عصوا», falling under its ruling; the wāw is the noun of «كان», and the clause «يعتدون» is the khabar of «كان». The clause ﴿ذلك بما عصوا﴾ is resumptive by way of explanation (istiʾnāf bayānī), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t:
﴿كانوا لا يتناهون عن منكر فعلوه﴾: The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. ﴿كان﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters); the wāw is its noun; the clause «لا يتناهون» is its khabar (predicate); ﴿عن منكر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿يتناهون﴾; and the clause «فعلوه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «منكر».
﴿لبئس ما كانوا يفعلون﴾: The lām is the answer to an omitted oath. «بئس» is a rigid (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); «ما» is a complete indefinite in the position of the accusative as a tamyīz (specification), or it is a relative noun and so is in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil, i.e. «الذي فعلوه» ("that which they did"). The clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is a naʿt of ﴿ما﴾, or it has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and the clause «يفعلون» is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of «كان».

muyesser-irab:80-80.t:
﴿ترى كثيرا منهم يتولون الذين كفروا﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «ترى» is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun whose implied form is «أنت» ("you"); «كثيرًا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «منهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كثيرًا﴾; the clause «يتولون» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), because the seeing here is visual; «الذين» is a direct object; and the clause «كفروا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿لبئس ما قدمت لهم أنفسهم أن سخط الله عليهم﴾: The lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath. «بئس»: a past verb for expressing blame, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿ما﴾: a qualified indefinite meaning «شيء» ("thing"), in the position of the accusative as a tamyīz (specification), and the clause ﴿قدمت﴾ is a naʿt of ﴿ما﴾; or ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil, and the clause «قدمت» is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. The clause of blame has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath. «لهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «قدمت»; «أنفسهم» is the fāʿil. ﴿أن سخط﴾: «أن» with what falls in its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) that is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later, its khabar (predicate) being the oath clause, as though it were said: «بئس زادهم في الآخرة سخط الله عليهم» ("wretched is their provision for the Hereafter: Allah's wrath upon them"); or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ.
﴿وفي العذاب هم خالدون﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; «في العذاب» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿خالدون﴾; «هم» is a mubtadaʾ, and «خالدون» is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:81-81.t:
﴿ولو كانوا يؤمنون بالله والنبي وما أنزل إليه﴾: The wāw is resumptive; «لو» is conditional; «كان» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), the wāw is its noun, and the clause «يؤمنون» is its khabar (predicate); «بالله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «يؤمنون»; «النبي» is conjoined to ﴿الله﴾; and «ما أنزل إليه» is also conjoined.
﴿ما اتخذوهم أولياء ولكن كثيرا منهم فاسقون﴾: The clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. «أولياء» is the second object of «اتخذ»; «لكن» is an abrogating particle, «كثيرا» is its noun and «فاسقون» is its khabar. The clause ﴿ولو كانوا يؤمنون...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:82-82.t:
﴿لتجدن أشد الناس عداوة للذين آمنوا اليهود والذين أشركوا﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. The lām is the answer to an omitted oath; «تجدن» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath. «أشد الناس» is the first object of «تجد»; «عداوة» is a tamyīz (specification); «للذين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أشد»; and «اليهود» is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). Or «أشد الناس» is the second object of «تجد» and «اليهود» the first object. «الذين» is conjoined to «اليهود», and the clause «أشركوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position.
﴿ولتجدن أقربهم مودة للذين آمنوا الذين قالوا إنا نصارى﴾: The wāw is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to what preceded; the clause «إنا نصارى» is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ذلك بأن منهم قسيسين ورهبانا﴾: The clause is resumptive and explanatory, with no grammatical position. The demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the bāʾ is a preposition; «أن» with what falls in its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar), genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿ذلك﴾. «منهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the omitted khabar of «أن», placed first; «قسيسين» is the noun of «أن»; and «رهبانًا» is conjoined to «قسيسين».
﴿وأنهم لا يستكبرون﴾: Conjoined to ﴿بأن منهم﴾, and the clause «لا يستكبرون» is the khabar of «أن».

muyesser-irab:83-83.t:
﴿وإذا سمعوا ما أنزل إلى الرسول﴾: The wāw is resumptive or a conjunction. «إذا» is an adverb of future time comprising the sense of condition; the clause «سمعوا» is in the position of the genitive because the adverb is put in construct with it, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «ما» is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «أنزل» has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and «إلى الرسول» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أنزل».
﴿ترى أعينهم تفيض من الدمع﴾: The clause has no position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. «ترى» is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun whose implied form is «أنت» ("you"); «أعينهم» is the object of the visual «ترى»; the clause «تفيض» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and «من الدمع» is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of the accusative as a tamyīz (specification). The clause ﴿وإذا سمعوا...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position, or conjoined to His words ﴿لا يستكبرون﴾.
﴿مما عرفوا من الحق﴾: The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تفيض»; the clause «عرفوا» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and «من الحق» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿يقولون ربنا آمنا فاكتبنا مع الشاهدين﴾: The clause «يقولون» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the pronoun in ﴿عرفوا﴾, namely the wāw, or from the genitive pronoun in ﴿أعينهم﴾ — a ḥāl may come from the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) because the muḍāf is part of it; or it is resumptive, introduced to answer an implied question, as though it were asked: "What is their state on hearing the Qurʾān?", and then it has no grammatical position. «ربنا» is the one addressed (munādā), in a genitive construct (muḍāf); «آمنا» is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فاكتبنا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; «اكتبنا» is a verb of supplication and a direct object, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); «مع الشاهدين» is an adverb attached to «اكتبنا»; and the clause ﴿فاكتبنا مع الشاهدين﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:84-84.t:
﴿وما لنا لا نؤمن بالله وما جاءنا من الحق﴾: The wāw is resumptive. «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); «لنا» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause «لا نؤمن بالله» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); «بالله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «نؤمن»; «ما» is conjoined to ﴿الله﴾; the clause «جاءنا» has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾; and «من الحق» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl. The clause ﴿وما لنا لا نؤمن...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿ونطمع أن يدخلنا ربنا مع القوم الصالحين﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; «نطمع» is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is «نحن» ("we"); «أن» with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «نطمع»; «ربنا» is the fāʿil [of «يدخلنا»]; and in «مع القوم الصالحين» the adverb is attached to «يدخلنا». The whole clause is conjoined to the clause «نؤمن»; or the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and the clause is in the accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿وقالت اليهود والنصارى﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (قالت اليهود) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and (النصارى) is conjoined to (اليهود).
﴿نحن أبناء الله وأحباؤه﴾: the clause is the object of their saying (maqūl al-qawl); (نحن) is the mubtadaʾ (subject); (أبناء الله) is the khabar (predicate); and (أحباؤه) is conjoined to (أبناء الله). The clause ﴿وقالت اليهود...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿قل فلم يعذبكم بذنوبكم﴾: the speech is resumptive, with no grammatical position. (قل) is an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "أنت"; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, i.e. "if you are as you claim, then why does He punish you for the sins you commit!"; in ﴿لم﴾ the lām is a preposition and (ما) is an interrogative noun whose alif has been dropped because the preposition has entered upon it, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يعذبكم); (يعذبكم) is an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is "هو"; (بذنوبكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun also attached to (يعذبكم); the whole clause is the object of their saying; and the clause (لم يعذبكم) has no grammatical position, because it occurs as the apodosis of a condition that does not make the verb jussive.
﴿بل أنتم بشر ممن خلق﴾: (بل) is a particle of digression (iḍrāb), conjoining to an omitted [clause] extracted from the sense of the preceding speech, i.e. "so you are not, then, of such a degree of nearness to Him, glory be to Him"; (أنتم) is the mubtadaʾ; (بشر) is the khabar; (ممن) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (بشر); and the clause (خلق) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿يغفر لمن يشاء ويعذب من يشاء﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (لمن) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (يغفر); the clause (يشاء) is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause (يعذب من يشاء) is conjoined to the preceding clause.
﴿ولله ملك السماوات والأرض وما بينهما وإليه المصير﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. (لله) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (ملك السماوات والأرض) is a postponed mubtadaʾ; (الأرض) is conjoined to (السماوات); (ما) is likewise conjoined; the adverb is attached to the omitted ṣila of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. In ﴿وإليه المصير﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; (إليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (المصير) is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿ولله ملك السماوات والأرض﴾.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿يا أهل الكتاب قد جاءكم رسولنا﴾: (يا) is a vocative particle; (أهل الكتاب) is a muḍāf munādā (one addressed in a genitive construct); (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (جاءكم رسولنا) is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil (agent); and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿يبين لكم على فترة من الرسل﴾: the clause (يبين) is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿رسولنا﴾, i.e. "explaining to you"; (لكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يبين); (على فترة) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (جاءكم), i.e. "he came to you at a time of lapse in the sending of messengers and interruption of revelation", or to an omitted element occurring as a ḥāl from the pronoun of (يبين) or from the pronoun of (لكم), i.e. "he explains to you what was mentioned while he is upon an interval of messengers", or "while you are upon it, most in need of explanation that you ever were"; and (من الرسل) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element occurring as a naʿt (adjective) of (فترة), i.e. "being [an interval] of messengers".
﴿أن تقولوا ما جاءنا من بشير ولا نذير﴾: ﴿أن تقولوا﴾: the maṣdar cast from (أن) and the verb after it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "out of aversion to your saying", or it is accusative by removal of the preposition with a negation assumed, i.e. "lest you say"; the clause (ما جاءنا) is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); (من) is a connective (ṣila) preposition; (بشير) is the fāʿil of (جاءنا) in position; and (لا نذير) is conjoined to (من بشير).
﴿فقد جاءكم بشير ونذير﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, i.e. "if you excuse yourselves with that, then a bringer of good tidings and a warner has come to you"; (جاءكم بشير) is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi and a fāʿil; (نذير) is conjoined to (بشير); and the clause has no grammatical position because it occurs as the apodosis of a condition that does not make the verb jussive.
﴿والله على كل شيء قدير﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); (قدير) is its khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (قدير); and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿وإذ قال موسى لقومه﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" ("remember"); ﴿قال موسى﴾ is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿قال موسى﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (لقومه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قال).
﴿يا قوم اذكروا نعمة الله عليكم﴾: the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). (يا) is a vocative particle; (قوم) is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; (اذكروا نعمة الله) is an imperative verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; and (عليكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نعمة﴾ if it is taken as a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "remember His bestowing [favour] upon you", or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿نعمة﴾ if it is taken as a noun, i.e. "remember His favour as being upon you".
﴿إذ جعل فيكم أنبياء وجعلكم ملوكا﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of ﴿نعمة الله﴾, attached to it on the assumption that ﴿نعمة﴾ is a maṣdar; or it is a noun, indeclinable on sukūn in the position of accusative as a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) for ﴿نعمة الله﴾; the clause ﴿جعل﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); (فيكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (جعل) as its first object; (أنبياء) is its second object; (جعلكم ملوكًا) is conjoined to what precedes; and (ملوكًا) is a second object.
﴿وآتاكم ما لم يؤت أحدا من العالمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (آتاكم) is a verb and a first object, and the fāʿil is "هو"; (ما) is a relative noun, a second object; the clause (لم يؤت أحدًا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and (من العالمين) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted ṣila of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. [Translator's note: so in the source; (من العالمين) more naturally qualifies (أحدًا), and the ṣila has already been identified as (لم يؤت أحدًا).]

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿يا قوم ادخلوا الأرض المقدسة﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (ادخلوا) is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); (الأرض) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa), or accusative by removal of the preposition, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ادخلوا); and (المقدسة) is a naʿt (adjective) of (الأرض).
﴿التي كتب الله لكم﴾: (التي) is a second naʿt of (الأرض); the clause (كتب الله) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿التي﴾, with no grammatical position; and (لكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (كتب).
﴿ولا ترتدوا على أدباركم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لا) is prohibitive; (ترتدوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا); the wāw is the fāʿil; and (على أدباركم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of (ترتدوا).
﴿فتنقلبوا خاسرين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (تنقلبوا) is conjoined to (ترتدوا), so it is jussive like it; or the fāʾ is causative (sababiyya), and (تنقلبوا) is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (أن) after it; and (خاسرين) is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿قالوا يا موسى إن فيها قوما جبارين﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (قالوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the vocative clause and what follows it are the object of their saying (maqūl al-qawl); (فيها) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of (إن); (قومًا) is its postponed noun (ism); and (جبارين) is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿قومًا﴾.
﴿وإنا لن ندخلها حتى يخرجوا منها﴾: the wāw conjoins to what precedes; (إن) is an abrogating particle; ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the clause (لن ندخلها) is its khabar; (حتى) is a particle of limit (ghāya) and genitive; (يخرجوا) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (أن) after it, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (ندخلها); and (منها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (يخرجوا).
﴿فإن يخرجوا منها فإنا داخلون﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (إن) is conditional; (يخرجوا) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ is linking because the clause after it is nominal and not fit to be an apodosis [without it]; (إن) is an abrogating particle; ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; (داخلون) is its khabar; and the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿قال رجلان من الذين يخافون﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. (قال رجلان) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (من الذين) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective); and the clause ﴿يخافون﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿أنعم الله﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil.
﴿عليهما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أنعم﴾. The clause ﴿أنعم الله عليهما﴾ is in the position of nominative as a second naʿt of ﴿رجلان﴾, or it is parenthetical and so has no grammatical position.
﴿ادخلوا عليهم الباب﴾: the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the two men's saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿فإذا دخلتموه فإنكم غالبون﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (إذا) is a future adverb containing the meaning of condition, and it is attached to ﴿غالبون﴾; the clause (دخلتموه) is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the fāʾ links the answer of (إذا); (إن) is an abrogating particle; the kāf is its noun (ism); and (غالبون) is its khabar (predicate).
﴿وعلى الله فتوكلوا إن كنتم مؤمنين﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. In ﴿فتوكلوا﴾ the fāʾ is the answer to an omitted command that must be assumed: "Be alert, and rely upon Allah"; (على الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (توكلوا); (إن) is conditional; (كنتم) is a defective past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is its noun; (مؤمنين) is its khabar; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "then rely".

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿قالوا يا موسى إنا لن ندخلها أبدا ما داموا فيها﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (قالوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the vocative clause and what follows it are in the position of accusative as the object of their saying (maqūl al-qawl); (إن) is an abrogating particle; ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿لن ندخلها﴾ is the khabar (predicate); (أبدًا) is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) (داخلها) [Translator's note: so in the source; presumably (ندخلها) is meant]; in ﴿ما داموا﴾, (ما) is maṣdariyya ẓarfiyya (forming a verbal noun of time), and (داموا) is the defective (دام); the wāw is its noun; ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar; and this adverbial is a badal muṭābiq (corresponding substitute) for ﴿أبدًا﴾, or a badal kull min kull (substitute of the whole for the whole), or a badal baʿḍ min kull (substitute of part for the whole).
﴿فاذهب أنت وربك فقاتلا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; ﴿اذهب﴾ is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت"; (أنت) is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent fāʿil; (ربك) is conjoined to the latent fāʿil in ﴿اذهب﴾; ﴿فقاتلا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿اذهب﴾; and the alif is the fāʿil of (قاتل).
﴿إنا ههنا قاعدون﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (إن) is an abrogating particle; ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; (ها) is for alerting (tanbīh); ﴿هنا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, and the adverb is attached to ﴿قاعدون﴾; and (قاعدون) is the khabar of (إن).

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿قال رب إني لا أملك إلا نفسي وأخي﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. (قال) is a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "هو"; (رب) is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; (إن) is an abrogating particle; the yāʾ is its noun (ism); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); the clause (لا أملك) is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (نفسي) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (أخي) is nominative (marfūʿ) as conjoined to the latent (mustatir) pronoun in ﴿أملك﴾, or conjoined to the position of (إن) and its noun, or it is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is omitted, the implied form being "and my brother possesses only himself"; or it is accusative (manṣūb) as conjoined to the noun of (إنّ), or conjoined to ﴿نفسي﴾; or genitive (majrūr) as conjoined to the yāʾ in ﴿نفسي﴾.
﴿فافرق بيننا وبين القوم الفاسقين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; (افرق) is a verb of supplication (duʿāʾ); (بيننا) is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿افرق﴾; (بين القوم الفاسقين) is conjoined to ﴿بيننا﴾; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿قال فإنها محرمة عليهم أربعين سنة يتيهون في الأرض﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The fāʿil (agent) of ﴿قال﴾ is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "Allah the Exalted"; the fāʾ is connective (ṣila); (إن) is an abrogating particle; the hāʾ is its noun (ism); (محرمة) is its khabar (predicate); (عليهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (محرمة); (أربعين) is an adverb of time attached to ﴿يتيهون﴾, or to (محرمة); (سنة) is a tamyīz (specification); the clause ﴿فإنها محرمة﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause ﴿يتيهون في الأرض﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "while they wander lost, roaming the mazes of the earth and the expanses of the deserts, buffeted by grief and assailed by bewilderment".
﴿فلا تأس على القوم الفاسقين﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, i.e. "if you know this, then do not grieve"; (لا) is prohibitive; (تأس) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive (لا), and the sign of its jussive is the dropping of the weak letter; (على القوم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تأس﴾; and (الفاسقين) is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿القوم﴾.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿واتل عليهم نبأ ابني آدم بالحق﴾: the clause is conjoined to the implied verb in His word ﴿وإذ قال موسى لقومه﴾, i.e. "Mention, O Muhammad, to your people, and recite to them."
﴿إذ قربا قربانا فتقبل من أحدهما ولم يتقبل من الآخر﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb for past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نبأ﴾; or it is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) for ﴿نبأ﴾, assuming an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "and recite to them the tidings, the tidings of that time". The clause ﴿قرّبا﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); (قربا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (قربانًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); in ﴿فتقبل﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (تقبل) is a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو", referring back to ﴿قربانًا﴾; (من أحدهما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (تقبل); and ﴿ولم يتقبل من الآخر﴾ is conjoined to (تقبل).
﴿قال لأقتلنك قال إنما يتقبل الله من المتقين﴾: the clause (لأقتلنك) is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath; (أقتلنك) is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa because it must be emphasised with the heavy nūn; the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi; (إنما) is the restraining and restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa); and the clause (إنما يتقبل الله من المتقين) is the object of the saying.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿لئن بسطت إلي يدك لتقتلني ما أنا بباسط يدي إليك لأقتلك﴾: the lām prepares for (muwaṭṭiʾa) the oath; (إن) is conditional; (بسطت) is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); (إليَّ) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (بسطت); (يدك) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. In ﴿لتقتلني﴾ the lām is causal (lām al-taʿlīl); (تقتلني) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (أن) after the causal lām; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya); the yāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (بسطت). ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating particle that operates like (ليس); ﴿أنا﴾ is the noun of (ما); in ﴿بباسط﴾ the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿باسط﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive in form by the bāʾ; ﴿يدي﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi of (باسط), because it is an active participle; ﴿إليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (باسط); in ﴿لأقتلك﴾ the lām is causal, and (أقتلك) is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (أن) after the causal lām; the clause is the answer to the oath because the oath precedes the condition; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because the answer to the oath indicates it.
﴿إني أخاف الله رب العالمين﴾: the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya); (إن) is an abrogating particle; the yāʾ is its noun (ism); the clause (أخاف الله) is its khabar; and (رب العالمين) is a badal (substitute) for ﴿الله﴾, or a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿إني أريد أن تبوء بإثمي وإثمك فتكون من أصحاب النار﴾: the clause is a second reason for his refraining from fighting, after the first reason. (إن) is an abrogating particle; the yāʾ is its noun (ism); the clause (أريد) is its khabar (predicate), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنا"; (أن تبوء) is an interpreted maṣdar in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿أريد﴾; (بإثمي) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of (تبوء), i.e. "you return carrying it" or "laden with it"; in ﴿فتكون﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ﴿تكون﴾ is a defective imperfect verb conjoined to ﴿تبوء﴾, accusative; its noun is "أنت"; and ﴿من أصحاب النار﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of (تكون).
﴿وذلك جزاء الظالمين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (ذلك) is a demonstrative in the position of nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); (جزاء الظالمين) is the khabar; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t: ﴿فطوعت له نفسه قتل أخيه فقتله فأصبح من الخاسرين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (طوعت) is a past verb; (له) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (طوعت); (نفسه) is the fāʿil (agent); (قتل أخيه) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (فقتله) is likewise conjoined; (فأصبح) is likewise conjoined, and its noun (ism) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; and ﴿من الخاسرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿فبعث الله غرابا يبحث في الأرض﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (بعث) is a past verb; ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); (غرابًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (يبحث في الأرض) is in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿غرابًا﴾; and (في الأرض) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يبحث).
﴿ليريه كيف يواري سوءة أخيه﴾: the lām is causal (li-l-taʿlīl); (يريه) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (أن) after the causal lām; the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi; (كيف) is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); the lām is causal, and ﴿يريه﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (أن); the interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied (أن) and ﴿يريه﴾ is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿بعث﴾, i.e. "He sent it in order to show him", so the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the verb ﴿يريه﴾ refers to Allah; or to (يبحث), so the latent pronoun refers to the crow, i.e. "it searches in order to show him"; and the interrogative clause suspends (muʿalliqa) the [verb of] visual seeing, so it is in the position of accusative as a second object, standing in its place.
﴿قال يا ويلتى﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. (قال) is a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent. (يا) is a particle of vocative, lament and lamentation (nudba); and ﴿ويلتا﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), accusative with an implied fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, which has been changed into an alif.
﴿أعجزت أن أكون مثل هذا الغراب﴾: the hamza is for interrogation and wonder; (عجزت) is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause falls within the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); (أن) is a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative; (أكون) is a defective imperfect verb, accusative by (أن); the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن أكون﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (عجزت), i.e. "Am I unable to be…"; the noun (ism) of (أكون) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنا"; (مثل) is the khabar (predicate) of (أكون); (هذا) is a demonstrative, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (الغراب) is a badal (substitute) for the demonstrative.
﴿فأواري سوءة أخي فأصبح من النادمين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (أواري) is an imperfect verb conjoined to ﴿أكون﴾; or it is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (أن) after the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya); (سوءة أخي) is a mafʿūl bihi; in ﴿فأصبح﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (أصبح) is a defective past verb; its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; and (من النادمين) is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿من أجل ذلك كتبنا على بني إسرائيل﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كتبنا); and (على بني إسرائيل) is a preposition and its genitive noun also attached to (كتبنا).
﴿أنه من قتل نفسا بغير نفس أو فساد في الأرض﴾: ﴿أن﴾ and what falls within its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of (كتبنا); the hāʾ is the noun (ism) of (أنّ), and it is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); (من) is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, and it is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (قتل) is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (نفسًا) is a mafʿūl bihi; (بغير نفس) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (قتل), or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent pronoun in ﴿قتل﴾, i.e. "he killed it unjustly"; (أو) is a conjunction; (فساد) is conjoined to (نفس), which is genitive by the annexation of (غير) to it; and (في الأرض) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (فساد).
﴿فكأنما قتل الناس جميعا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (كأنما) is the restraining and restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (قتل الناس) is a past verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi; (جميعًا) is a ḥāl; the clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of ﴿من﴾; and the conditional clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of ﴿أنه﴾.
﴿ومن أحياها فكأنما أحيا الناس جميعا﴾: conjoined to what precedes. (مَن) is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, and it is a mubtadaʾ; (أحياها) is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis, and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi; in ﴿فكأنما﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, and (كأنما) is the restraining and restrained particle; (أحيا الناس) is a past verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; (جميعًا) is a ḥāl; the clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of ﴿مَن﴾.
﴿ولقد جاءتهم رسلنا بالبينات﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); the clause (قد جاءتهم) has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to the oath; (رسلنا) is the fāʿil; and (بالبينات) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (جاءتهم), with no grammatical position, because it is the answer to the oath. [Translator's note: the closing phrase "with no grammatical position, because it is the answer to the oath" is repeated in the source after (بالبينات), apparently by copying.]
﴿ثم إن كثيرا منهم بعد ذلك في الأرض لمسرفون﴾: (ثم) is a conjunction for sequence with delay; (إن) is an abrogating particle; (كثيرا) is its noun; (منهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿كثيرًا﴾; the adverb [(بعد)] is attached to an omitted ḥāl; (ذلك) is a demonstrative in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); (في الأرض) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿مسرفون﴾; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and (مسرفون) is the khabar of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:85-85.t:
﴿فأثابهم الله بما قالوا جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾: The fāʾ is a conjunction; «أثابهم» is a verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, and ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to the clause «قالوا آمنا». «بما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿أثابهم﴾; the clause «قالوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; «جنات» is the second object of ﴿أثابهم﴾, because it includes the sense of giving; the clause «تجري» is a naʿt (adjective) of «جنات»; «من تحتها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «تجري»; and «الأنهار» is the fāʿil of «تجري».
﴿خالدين فيها وذلك جزاء المحسنين﴾: «خالدين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in ﴿أثابهم﴾, and «فيها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «خالدين». The wāw is circumstantial or resumptive; «ذلك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and «جزاء المحسنين» is its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿وذلك جزاء المحسنين﴾ is in the accusative as a ḥāl, or resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:86-86.t:
﴿والذين كفروا وكذبوا بآياتنا﴾: The wāw is resumptive; «الذين» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «كفروا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position; «كذبوا» is conjoined to «كفروا»; and «بآياتنا» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «كذبوا».
﴿أولئك أصحاب الجحيم﴾: The demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ, and «أصحاب الجحيم» is the khabar (predicate) of the demonstrative; the clause is the khabar of «الذين». The clause ﴿والذين كفروا...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:87-87.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تحرموا طيبات ما أحل الله لكم﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «يا» is a vocative particle; «أيّ» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; «ها» is for drawing attention; «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; «آمنوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position. «لا» is prohibitive; «تحرموا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا», and the wāw is the fāʿil; «طيبات» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «ما» is a relative noun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause «أحل» is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil; and «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أحل».
﴿ولا تعتدوا إن الله لا يحب المعتدين﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; «لا» is prohibitive; «تعتدوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive by «لا»; and the clause is conjoined to the clause «لا تحرموا». «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Divine Name is its noun, and the clause «لا يحب المعتدين» is its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿إن الله...﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:88-88.t:
﴿وكلوا مما رزقكم الله حلالا طيبا﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; «كلوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; «مما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿كلوا﴾; and the clause «رزقكم الله» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «حلالًا»: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun or from its omitted resumptive pronoun; or it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a qualifier of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. «أكلًا حلالًا» ("a lawful eating").
﴿واتقوا الله الذي أنتم به مؤمنون﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; «اتقوا» is an imperative verb conjoined to «كلوا», and ﴿الله﴾ is its object; «الذي» is a naʿt (adjective) of «الله»; «أنتم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «به» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿مؤمنون﴾; and the nominal clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.

muyesser-irab:89-89.t:
﴿لا يؤاخذكم الله باللغو في أيمانكم﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «لا» is negating; «يؤاخذكم الله» is an imperfect verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil (agent); «باللغو» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «يؤاخذكم»; and «في أيمانكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ولكن يؤاخذكم بما عقدتم الأيمان﴾: The wāw is a conjunction, and «لكن» is inoperative (muhmala). In «بما» the bāʾ is a preposition, and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming, interpreted together with ﴿عقدتم﴾ as a maṣdar genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يؤاخذكم﴾; and «الأيمان» is the direct object.
﴿فكفارته إطعام عشرة مساكين من أوسط ما تطعمون أهليكم﴾: The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that presupposes an implied condition), i.e. «إذا حنثتم فيما عقدتم الأيمان فكفارته» ("if you break what you have bound by oaths, then its expiation…"), so it is the apodosis of an implied condition. «كفارته» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the pronoun refers back to the oath-breaking understood from the implied condition, as stated; or it refers back to the relative ﴿ما﴾, in which case an omitted muḍāf must be supposed, i.e. «كفارة حنثه» ("the expiation for breaking it"). «إطعام» is the khabar (predicate); «عشرة مساكين» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «من أوسط» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «عشرة مساكين»; «ما» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause «تطعمون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position, the resumptive pronoun being omitted, i.e. «تطعمونه» ("you feed it"); and «أهليكم» is the object of «تطعمون».
﴿أو كسوتهم أو تحرير رقبة﴾: Conjoined to «طعام» [Translator's note: so in the source; the word in the verse is «إطعام»], and likewise «تحرير رقبة».
﴿فمن لم يجد فصيام ثلاثة أيام﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. «من» is a jussive-governing conditional noun, a mubtadaʾ; «لم» is a particle of negation, inversion [of tense] and jussive; «يجد» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم», and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ links its apodosis; «صيام» is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. «فعليه صيام» ("then upon him is fasting"), or «كفارته» ("its expiation is…"); and «ثلاثة أيام» is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ذلك كفارة أيمانكم إذا حلفتم﴾: The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. The demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ, «كفارة» is the khabar, and «أيمانكم» is muḍāf ilayhi. «إذا» is an adverb of future time comprising the sense of condition, attached to the omitted apodosis that what precedes indicates; and the clause «حلفتم» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿واحفظوا أيمانكم كذلك يبين الله لكم آياته لعلكم تشكرون﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; ﴿احفظوا﴾ is an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and ﴿أيمانكم﴾ is the direct object. ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar placed before its governor, i.e. «تبيينًا مثل ذلك يبين الله لكم آياته» ("with a clarification like that Allah clarifies His signs to you"). ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address. ﴿يبين﴾ is an imperfect verb and ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿يبين﴾; and ﴿آياته﴾ is the direct object. ﴿لعلكم﴾: «لعل» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the kāf is its noun, and the clause ﴿تشكرون﴾ is its khabar; the clause of hope is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:90-90.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا إنما الخمر والميسر والأنصاب والأزلام رجس من عمل الشيطان﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «يا» is a vocative particle; «أيّ» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; «ها» is for drawing attention; «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; «آمنوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position. «إنما» is the restraining «ما» with the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa); «الخمر» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «الميسر» and «الأنصاب» and «الأزلام» are conjoined to it; «رجس» is the khabar (predicate); and «من عمل الشيطان» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted naʿt of «رجس», or it is a second khabar of «الخمر».
﴿فاجتنبوه لعلكم تفلحون﴾: The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that presupposes an implied condition); «اجتنبوه» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «لعل» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the kāf is its noun, and the clause «تفلحون» is its khabar; the clause of hope is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:91-91.t:
﴿إنما يريد الشيطان أن يوقع بينكم العداوة والبغضاء في الخمر والميسر﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «إنما» is the restraining «ما» with the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa); «يريد الشيطان» is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); «أن» with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar), the object of «يريد»; «بينكم» is an adverb attached to «يوقع» or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «العداوة» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «البغضاء» is conjoined to «العداوة»; «في الخمر» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl; and «الميسر» is conjoined to «الخمر».
﴿ويصدكم عن ذكر الله وعن الصلاة﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; «يصدكم» is conjoined to «يوقع»; «عن ذكر الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «يصدكم»; and «عن الصلاة» is a preposition and its genitive noun, likewise attached to «يصدكم».
﴿فهل أنتم منتهون﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive; «هل» is an interrogative particle whose meaning is a command; «أنتم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and «منتهون» is the khabar (predicate); and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:92-92.t:
﴿وأطيعوا الله وأطيعوا الرسول واحذروا﴾: The wāw is a conjunction, and the speech is conjoined to the interrogative in the preceding verse, because the interrogative has the sense of a command, as stated before; the meaning is: «انتهوا وأطيعوا» ("desist and obey"). Or the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. «أطيعوا الله» is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «أطيعوا الرسول» is conjoined to «أطيعوا الله»; and «احذروا» is also conjoined.
﴿فإن توليتم فاعلموا أنما على رسولنا البلاغ المبين﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive; «إن» is conditional; «توليتم» is a past verb and its fāʿil, and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فاعلموا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being «فجزاؤكم علينا» ("then your recompense is upon Us"), and the clause «فاعلموا» is conjoined to the apodosis. «أنما» is the restraining «ما» with the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa), and it, together with what it governs, stands in place of the two objects of «اعلموا». «على رسولنا» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; «البلاغ» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later; and «المبين» is a naʿt (adjective). The clause ﴿فإن توليتم...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:93-93.t:
﴿ليس على الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات جناح فيما طعموا﴾: The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. «ليس» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb (kāna and its sisters); «على الذين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of «ليس», placed first; the clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the clause «عملوا الصالحات» is conjoined to the ṣila, with no grammatical position; «جناح» is the noun of «ليس», placed later; «فيما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «جناح»; and the clause «طعموا» has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿إذا ما اتقوا وآمنوا وعملوا الصالحات﴾: «إذا» is an adverb of future time comprising the sense of condition; «ما» is connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant); the clause «اتقوا» is in the position of the genitive because the adverb is put in construct with it. What governs «إذا» is the sense of negation in «ليس», i.e. sin is negated from them. The apodosis of «إذا» is omitted, indicated by what precedes, i.e. «فليس عليهم جناح» ("then there is no blame on them"). «آمنوا» is conjoined to «اتقوا», and «عملوا الصالحات» is also conjoined to what preceded.
﴿ثم اتقوا وآمنوا ثم اتقوا وأحسنوا﴾: Also conjoined.
﴿والله يحب المحسنين﴾: The wāw is resumptive; ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause «يحب» is the khabar, and «المحسنين» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:94-94.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا ليبلونكم الله بشيء من الصيد﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «يا» is a vocative particle; «أيّ» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; «ها» is for drawing attention; «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; «آمنوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position. In «ليبلونكم» the lām is the answer to an omitted oath, i.e. «والله ليبلونكم» ("by Allah, He will surely test you"); «يبلون» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and ﴿الله﴾ is its fāʿil; «بشيء» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «يبلونكم»; «من الصيد» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted naʿt of «شيء»; and the clause «يبلونكم» has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the omitted oath.
﴿تناله أيديكم ورماحكم ليعلم الله من يخافه بالغيب﴾: The clause is a naʿt of «شيء»; «أيديكم» is the fāʿil of «تناله», and «رماحكم» is conjoined to «أيديكم». The lām is causal; «يعلم» is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by a concealed «أن» after the lām; «أن» and the verb after it are interpreted as a genitive maṣdar, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يبلونكم». ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil of «يعلم»; «من» is a relative noun, the object of «يعلم»; the clause «يخافه» has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; and «بالغيب» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of «يخاف», i.e. he fears Allah while being absent from Allah; or from the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. he fears Allah, He being clothed in the unseen.
﴿فمن اعتدى بعد ذلك فله عذاب أليم﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive; «من» is a jussive-governing conditional noun; «اعتدى» is a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); in ﴿بعد ذلك﴾ the adverb is attached to «اعتدى», and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فله﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; «له» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; «عذاب» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later; «أليم» is a naʿt; and the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The protasis together with its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿من﴾, and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:95-95.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تقتلوا الصيد وأنتم حرم﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «لا» is prohibitive; «تقتلوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive «لا», and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «الصيد» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). In «وأنتم» the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «أنتم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and «حرم» is its khabar (predicate); and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of «تقتلوا».
﴿ومن قتله منكم متعمدا فجزاء مثل ما قتل من النعم﴾: The wāw is resumptive. «من» is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, its khabar being the clause of the condition and the apodosis. «قتله» is a past verb, a latent fāʿil and a direct object, and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «منكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil of «قتل»; and «متعمدًا» is likewise a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «قتل», i.e. mindful of his iḥrām, or knowing that what he kills is among what it is forbidden for him to kill. «فجزاء»: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «جزاء» is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. «فعليه جزاء» ("then upon him is a recompense"), or it is a khabar whose mubtadaʾ is omitted, i.e. «فالواجب عليه جزاء» ("then what is due from him is a recompense"); and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. «مثل» is a naʿt (adjective) of «جزاء»; «ما» is a relative noun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) of «مثل»; the clause «قتل» is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and «من النعم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl from «مثل». The clause ﴿ومن قتله...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿يحكم به ذوا عدل منكم هديا بالغ الكعبة﴾: The clause «يحكم» is a second naʿt of «جزاء»; «به» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «يحكم»; «ذوا» is the fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the alif because it is dual; «عدل» is muḍāf ilayhi; «منكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿ذوا﴾; «هديًا» is a ḥāl from «جزاء», or accusative as a maṣdar, i.e. «يهديه هديًا» ("he offers it as an offering"), or accusative as a tamyīz (specification); and «بالغ الكعبة» is a naʿt of ﴿هديًا﴾.
﴿أو كفارة طعام مساكين أو عدل ذلك صياما﴾: «أو» is a conjunction; «كفارة» is conjoined to «جزاء»; «طعام مساكين» is a badal (substitute) from «كفارة»; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; «عدل» is conjoined to «كفارة»; «ذلك» is muḍāf ilayhi; and «صيامًا» is a tamyīz of «العدل».
﴿ليذوق وبال أمره عفا الله عما سلف﴾: The lām is causal; «يذوق» is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by a concealed «أن» after the causal lām. The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the notion of "being established" (al-istiqrār) latent in the khabar [Translator's note: the source has the typo «الاستقرا٩ر»], i.e. «عليه الجزاء ليذوق» ("upon him is the recompense, that he may taste…"); or they are attached to «طعام» or «صيام»; or attached to ﴿جزاء﴾, i.e. «فعليه أن يجازى ليذوق سوء عاقبة هتكه لحرمة الإحرام» ("it is upon him to be recompensed, that he may taste the evil consequence of his violating the sanctity of iḥrām"). The clause ﴿عفا الله...﴾ is resumptive, i.e. He did not take you to account for the game you killed in the state of iḥrām in the past, before it was forbidden; it is a clause with no grammatical position. «عما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «عفا», and the clause «سلف» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿ومن عاد فينتقم الله منه﴾: The wāw is resumptive; «من» is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; «عاد» is a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis; the fāʾ is linking; «ينتقم الله» is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. «فهو ينتقم الله منه» ("then he — Allah will take retribution from him"); the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis together with its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿من﴾. «منه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «ينتقم». The clause ﴿ومن عاد...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿والله عزيز ذو انتقام﴾: The wāw is resumptive; ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, «عزيز» is a first khabar, and «ذو انتقام» is a second khabar; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:96-96.t:
﴿أحل لكم صيد البحر وطعامه متاعا لكم وللسيارة﴾: «أحل» is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أحلَّ»; «صيد البحر» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and «طعامه» is conjoined to ﴿صيد﴾. «متاعًا»: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. «لأجل تمتعكم» ("for your enjoyment"); or it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of maṣdar for an omitted verb, i.e. «متعكم تمتيعًا» ("He gave you enjoyment"). «لكم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿متاعًا﴾; «للسيارة» is conjoined to ﴿لكم﴾; and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وحرم عليكم صيد البر ما دمتم حرما﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; «حرم» is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); «عليكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «حرّم»; the clause is conjoined to the preceding clause; and «صيد البر» is the nāʾib fāʿil. «ما دمتم» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; ﴿ما﴾ with what follows it is in the position of the accusative as an adverb, and the adverb is attached to «حرم»; the tāʾ is the noun of «ما دام», and «حرمًا» is its khabar (predicate).
﴿واتقوا الله الذي إليه تحشرون﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; «اتقوا الله» is an imperative verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «الذي» is a naʿt (adjective); «إليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «تحشرون»; «تحشرون» is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; and the clause «تحشرون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:97-97.t:
﴿جعل الله الكعبة البيت الحرام قياما للناس والشهر الحرام والهدي والقلائد﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. ﴿جعل﴾ has the sense of «صيَّر» ("made [into]"), or the sense of «خلق» ("created"). ﴿جعل الله﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «الكعبة» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «البيت الحرام» is a badal (substitute) from «الكعبة»; «قيامًا» is, on the first [sense], a second direct object, and on the second, a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الكعبة»; «للناس» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿قيامًا﴾, i.e. they sustain the affairs of their livelihood and their benefits by repairing to it; «الشهر» is conjoined to «الكعبة», and «الحرام» is a naʿt (adjective); and «الهدي» and «القلائد» are also conjoined to «الكعبة».
﴿ذلك لتعلموا أن الله يعلم ما في السماوات وما في الأرض﴾: The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. The demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject), the reference being to the whole of what was mentioned before. ﴿لتعلموا﴾: the lām is the causal lām; «تعلموا» is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by a concealed «أن» after the lām; «أن» and the verb after it are interpreted as a maṣdar, genitive by the lām; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of «ذلك», i.e. «ذلك الحكم هو الحق لا غيره» ("that ruling is the truth and nothing else"). Or ﴿ذلك﴾ is in the place of the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. «الحكم الذي قررناه ذلك» ("the ruling We have laid down is that"); or it is accusative by an implied verb, to which «لتعلموا» — a preposition and its genitive noun — is attached, i.e. «شرعنا ذلك» ("We have legislated that"). «أن» with what follows it stands in place of the two objects of «تعلموا»; «أن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Divine Name is its noun, and the clause «يعلم» is its khabar; «ما» is a relative noun, a direct object; «في السماوات» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted [verb that is the] ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; and «ما في الأرض» is conjoined to ﴿ما في السماوات﴾.
﴿وأن الله بكل شيء عليم﴾: Conjoined to the first ﴿أن﴾. «أن» is an abrogating particle, and the Divine Name is its noun; ﴿بكل شيء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿عليم﴾; and «عليم» is the khabar of «أن».

muyesser-irab:98-98.t:
﴿اعلموا أن الله شديد العقاب﴾: «اعلموا» is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «أن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Divine Name is its noun, «شديد» is its khabar (predicate), and «العقاب» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن﴾ and what falls in its scope stands in place of the two objects of ﴿اعلموا﴾.
﴿وأن الله غفور رحيم﴾: Conjoined to what preceded. «أن» is an abrogating particle, the Divine Name is its noun, and «غفور رحيم» are the two khabars of ﴿أن﴾.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿إنما جزاء الذين يحاربون الله ورسوله﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (إنما) is the restraining and restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (جزاء) is the mubtadaʾ (subject); (الذين) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause (يحاربون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿الله﴾ is its object; and (رسوله) is conjoined to ﴿الله﴾.
﴿ويسعون في الأرض فسادا﴾: ﴿ويسعون﴾ is conjoined to (يحاربون); (في الأرض) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يسعون); and (فسادًا) is a mafʿūl min ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "they wage war and strive for the sake of corruption"; or it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) occurring in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "and they strive in the land as corrupters"; or it is accusative as a maṣdar, the implied form being "they corrupt in the land by their striving, a corrupting".
﴿أن يقتلوا أو يصلبوا أو تقطع أيديهم وأرجلهم من خلاف أو ينفوا من الأرض﴾: the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن﴾ and what falls within its scope is the khabar (predicate) of (جزاء); (أو) is a conjunction; (يصلبوا) is conjoined to (يقتلوا); (تقطع) is also conjoined to (يقتلوا); (أيديهم) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of (تقطع); (أرجلهم) is conjoined to (أيديهم); (من خلاف) is attached to an omitted ḥāl from (أيديهم) and (أرجلهم), i.e. "cut off alternately", meaning that his right hand and his left foot are cut off; (ينفوا) is also conjoined; and (من الأرض) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (ينفوا).
﴿ذلك لهم خزي في الدنيا﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The demonstrative is in the position of nominative as a mubtadaʾ; (لهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (خزي) is a postponed mubtadaʾ; (في الدنيا) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (خزي); and the nominal clause is the khabar of the demonstrative. Or ﴿خزي﴾ is the khabar of ﴿ذلك﴾, and (لهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl from (خزي).
﴿ولهم في الآخرة عذاب عظيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (في الآخرة) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; (عذاب) is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and (عظيم) is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
