﴿إلا الذين تابوا من قبل أن تقدروا عليهم﴾: the clause of exception is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from those who are punished. ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of exception; (الذين) is the excepted (mustathnā); the clause (تابوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; (من قبل) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تابوا), and ﴿قبل﴾ is made genitive with kasra because of annexation (iḍāfa); (أن) is a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative; (تقدروا) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by (أن), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن تقدروا﴾ is genitive by annexation; and (عليهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تقدروا﴾.
﴿فاعلموا أن الله غفور رحيم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; (اعلموا) is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أن) is an abrogating particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); (غفور رحيم) are its two predicates; the clause stands in the place of the two objects of ﴿اعلموا﴾; and the clause ﴿فاعلموا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (يا) is a vocative particle; (أي) is the one addressed (munādā), a specified indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of accusative; (ها) is for alerting (tanbīh); (الذين) is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; (آمنوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause (آمنوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position.
﴿اتقوا الله وابتغوا إليه الوسيلة﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (اتقوا الله) is an imperative verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (ابتغوا) is conjoined to (اتقوا); (إليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ابتغوا) or to (الوسيلة); and (الوسيلة) is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وجاهدوا في سبيله لعلكم تفلحون﴾: conjoined to what precedes. (لعل) is an abrogating particle; the kāf is its noun (ism); the clause (تفلحون) is its khabar (predicate); and the clause of hope (rajāʾ) is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿إن الذين كفروا لو أن لهم ما في الأرض جميعا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (إن) is an abrogating particle; (الذين) is its noun (ism); (لو) is conditional; (أن) is an abrogating particle; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of ﴿أن﴾; (ما) is a relative noun, its postponed noun; (أن) and what falls within its scope are a maṣdar, nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "ثبت" ("it were established"), or in the position of nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); (في الأرض) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. The clause of the condition and its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿إن﴾; and (جميعًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ومثله معه ليفتدوا به من عذاب يوم القيامة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿مثله﴾ is conjoined to the noun of (أن), namely the relative ﴿ما﴾. Or the wāw is of accompaniment (maʿiyya), and (مثله) is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), governed by the verb omitted before the fāʿil, or by a similar verb if ﴿أن﴾ and what follows it are an initial (nominal) clause. (معه) is an adverb of place attached to an omitted ḥāl; the lām is the causal lām (lām al-taʿlīl); (يفتدوا) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (أن) after the causal lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the [notion of] being-established to which the khabar, namely ﴿لهم﴾, is attached; (به) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (يفتدوا); and (من عذاب يوم القيامة) is a preposition and its genitive noun also attached to (يفتدوا).
﴿ما تقبل منهم﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a condition that does not make the verb jussive; the apodosis comes, as is most common, without a lām because it is negated.
﴿ولهم عذاب أليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or the wāw is a conjunction. (لهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (عذاب) is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and (أليم) is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿يريدون أن يخرجوا من النار وما هم بخارجين منها﴾: the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿يريدون﴾ is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿أن﴾ and what falls within its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of (يريدون); ﴿من النار﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يخرجون); the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating particle that operates like (ليس); ﴿هم﴾ is a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as the noun of (ما); in ﴿بخارجين﴾ the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿خارجين﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive in form by the bāʾ; and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ولهم عذاب مقيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, or a conjunction; (لهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (عذاب) is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); (مقيم) is a naʿt (adjective); and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿والسارق والسارقة فاقطعوا أيديهما﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (السارق) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "among what is recited to you", or "among what is prescribed for you is the male thief and the female thief", i.e. the ruling concerning them; so the muḍāf, which is ﴿حكم﴾ ("ruling"), was omitted and the muḍāf ilayhi, which is (السارق والسارقة), was put in its place. Or the khabar is the imperative clause, namely His word ﴿فاقطعوا﴾. (السارقة) is conjoined to (السارق); the fāʾ occurs in the answer of the relative ﴿ال﴾; (اقطعوا) is an imperative verb; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and (أيديهما) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿جزاء بما كسبا نكالا من الله﴾: (جزاء) is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "for the sake of requital"; or accusative as a maṣdar by an implied verb, i.e. "requite them with a requital"; or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil, i.e. "requiting them by cutting". In ﴿بما﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition meaning causation, i.e. "because of what they earned"; (ما) is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جزاء); or ﴿ما﴾ is a relative, i.e. "because of the theft that they committed", and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. (نكالًا) is accusative just as (جزاء) is, or it is a badal (substitute) for it; and (من الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿نكالًا﴾.
﴿والله عزيز حكيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ; (عزيز) is the first khabar, and (حكيم) the second; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿فمن تاب من بعد ظلمه وأصلح فإن الله يتوب عليه﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; (من) is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, and it is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (تاب) is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ links the apodosis; (إن) is an abrogating particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); the clause (يتوب) is its khabar (predicate); and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of (من). The clause ﴿فمن تاب...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله غفور رحيم﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun; (غفور رحيم) are its two predicates; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿ألم تعلم أن الله له ملك السماوات والأرض﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. The hamza is for interrogation that affirms (taqrīr) what follows the negation; (لم) is a particle of negation, inversion [of tense] and jussive; (تعلم) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لم); ﴿أن﴾ and what falls within its scope stand in the place of the two objects of (تعلم); (أن) is an abrogating particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (ملك السماوات) is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); (الأرض) is conjoined to (السماوات); and the nominal clause is the khabar of (أن).
﴿يعذب من يشاء ويغفر لمن يشاء﴾: the verbal clause is a second khabar of ﴿أن﴾, or a ḥāl (circumstantial); (من) is a relative noun, the object of (يعذب); the clause (يشاء) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; (يغفر) is conjoined to (يعذب); and (لمن يشاء) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (يغفر).
﴿والله على كل شيء قدير﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (الله) is the mubtadaʾ; (على كل شيء) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (قدير); (قدير) is the khabar of ﴿الله﴾; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:99-99.t:
﴿ما على الرسول إلا البلاغ﴾: The speech is resumptive with no grammatical position. «ما» is negating; «على الرسول» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; «إلا» is a particle of restriction; and «البلاغ» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later.
﴿والله يعلم ما تبدون وما تكتمون﴾: The wāw is resumptive; ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause «يعلم» is the khabar; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the object of «يعلم»; the clause «تبدون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «ما تكتمون» is conjoined to His words «ما تبدون»; and the clause ﴿والله يعلم ما تبدون﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:100-100.t:
﴿قل لا يستوي الخبيث والطيب﴾: The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. «قل» is an imperative verb, and the clause «لا يستوي الخبيث والطيب» is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ولو أعجبك كثرة الخبيث﴾: The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «لو» is conditional; «أعجبك» is a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «كثرة الخبيث» is the fāʿil (agent) of «أعجبك»; and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of «لا يستوي», i.e. they are not equal, being so in every state. The apodosis of «لو» is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. «فلا يستويان» ("then they are not equal").
﴿فاتقوا الله يا أولي الألباب لعلكم تفلحون﴾: The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that presupposes an implied condition), i.e. «إذا تبين لكم هذا فاتقوا الله» ("since this has become clear to you, fear Allah"). «اتقوا الله» is a verb, its fāʿil and a direct object; «يا» is a vocative particle; «أولي الألباب» is the one addressed (munādā), in a genitive construct (muḍāf). «لعلكم»: «لعل» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the kāf is its noun, and the clause «تفلحون» is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:101-101.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تسألوا عن أشياء إن تبد لكم تسؤكم﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «يا» is a vocative particle; «أيّ» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; «ها» is for drawing attention; «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; «آمنوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position. «لا» is prohibitive; «تسألوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا», and the wāw is the fāʿil; «عن أشياء» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «تسألوا». «إن» is conditional; «تبد» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and it is built for that whose agent is not named (passive), its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) referring back to «أشياء»; «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿تبد﴾; «تسؤكم» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The conditional clause is a naʿt of ﴿أشياء﴾.
﴿وإن تسألوا عنها حين ينزل القرآن تبد لكم﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; «إن» is conditional; «تسألوا» is the protasis; «حين» is an adverb of time attached to «تسألوا»; the clause «ينزل القرآن» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «تبد» is the apodosis; and «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿تبد﴾.
﴿عفا الله عنها﴾: A resumptive clause with no grammatical position, or a second naʿt of ﴿أشياء﴾.
﴿والله غفور حليم﴾: The wāw is resumptive; ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «غفور» is a first khabar (predicate), and «حليم» is a second khabar; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:102-102.t: ﴿قد سألها قوم من قبلكم ثم أصبحوا بها كافرين﴾: The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, or a second naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أشياء﴾. «سألها» is a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, the pronoun referring back to ﴿أشياء﴾, and an omitted muḍāf must be supposed, i.e. «سأل مثلها» ("asked the like of them"); «قوم» is the fāʿil (agent); «من قبلكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted naʿt of «قوم»; «ثم» is a conjunction for sequence with delay; «أصبحوا»: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw being its noun; «بها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿كافرين﴾; and «كافرين» is the khabar (predicate) of «أصبحوا».

muyesser-irab:103-103.t:
﴿ما جعل الله من بحيرة ولا سائبة ولا وصيلة ولا حام﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «ما» is negating. «جعل» has the sense of «خلق» ("created"), so it takes one object; or the sense of «صيّر» ("made [into]"), so it takes two, the second being omitted, i.e. «صيرها مشروعة» ("made them legislated"). ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); «من» is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; «بحيرة» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), genitive in form and accusative in position; and what follows it is conjoined to it.
﴿ولكن الذين كفروا يفترون على الله الكذب﴾: The wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿لكن﴾ is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and «الذين» is its noun; the clause «كفروا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause «يفترون» is the khabar (predicate) of «لكن»; «على الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿يفترون﴾; and «الكذب» is a direct object.
﴿وأكثرهم لا يعقلون﴾: The wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial; «أكثرهم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «لا يعقلون» is the khabar of «أكثرهم».

muyesser-irab:104-104.t:
﴿وإذا قيل لهم تعالوا إلى ما أنزل الله وإلى الرسول﴾: The wāw is resumptive or a conjunction. «إذا» is an adverb of future time comprising the sense of condition, attached to the apodosis that follows; the clause «تعالوا» is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); in ﴿إلى ما أنزل الله﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تعالوا»; «أنزل الله» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and «إلى الرسول» is conjoined to it.
﴿قالوا حسبنا ما وجدنا عليه آباءنا﴾: The clause «قالوا» has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. «حسبنا» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «ما» is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate); the clause «وجدنا» has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; «عليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «وجدنا»; and «آباءنا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿وإذا قيل لهم...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position, or conjoined.
﴿أولو كان آباؤهم لا يعلمون شيئا ولا يهتدون﴾: The hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval and rebuke. The wāw is a conjunction joining to something implied, its implied form being «أحسبهم ذلك؟» ("Is that sufficient for them?"); or it is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), i.e. even if their fathers were ignorant and astray. «لو» is conditional, and its apodosis is omitted, its implied form being «يقولوا ذلك» ("they would say that"). «كان» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters); «آباؤهم» is its noun; the clause «لا يعلمون» is its khabar; «شيئًا» is a direct object; and the clause ﴿لا يهتدون﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿لا يعلمون﴾.

muyesser-irab:105-105.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا عليكم أنفسكم﴾: The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. «يا» is a vocative particle; «أيّ» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; «ها» is for drawing attention; «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; «آمنوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position. «عليكم» is a transferred verbal noun of command (ism fiʿl amr) meaning «الزموا» ("hold to"), and «أنفسكم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verbal noun.
﴿لا يضركم من ضل إذا اهتديتم﴾: The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. «لا» is negating; «يضركم» is an imperfect verb, and the kāf is a direct object; «من» is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of «يضركم»; the clause «ضل» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «إذا» is an adverb of future time comprising the sense of condition, attached to the implied apodosis, i.e. «فلا يضركم» ("then he will not harm you"); and the clause «اهتديتم» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إلى الله مرجعكم جميعا فينبئكم بما كنتم تعملون﴾: The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; «مرجعكم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later; and «جميعًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فينبئكم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «ينبئكم» is a verb, a latent fāʿil and a direct object; «بما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «ينبئكم»; the clause «كنتم» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the tāʾ is the noun of «كان», and the clause «تعملون» is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:106-106.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا شهادة بينكم إذا حضر أحدكم الموت حين الوصية اثنان ذوا عدل منكم﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «يا» is a vocative particle; «أيّ» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; «ها» is for drawing attention; «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; «آمنوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position. «شهادة» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «بينكم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «إذا» is an adverb of future time comprising the sense of condition, attached to the omitted apodosis, i.e. «فشهادة اثنين» ("then the testimony of two"); the clause «حضر أحدكم الموت» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; and «حين الوصية» is an adverb attached to «حضر». «اثنان» is the khabar (predicate) of «شهادة», and an omitted muḍāf must be supposed so that the mubtadaʾ and khabar correspond, because the testimony is not itself the two [persons], since a concrete entity cannot be the khabar of a maṣdar. Or ﴿شهادة﴾ is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. «فيما فرض عليكم شهادة» ("among what has been prescribed for you is testimony"), and «اثنان» is the fāʿil of «شهادة», i.e. «أن يشهد اثنان» ("that two should testify"). «ذوا عدل» is a naʿt of ﴿اثنان﴾, and «منكم» is also a naʿt.
﴿أو آخران من غيركم﴾: «أو» is a conjunction; «آخران»: conjoined to ﴿اثنان﴾; «من غيركم»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿آخران﴾, i.e. from other than your religious community. The kāf: an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿إن أنتم ضربتم في الأرض﴾: «إن»: conditional. «أنتم»: the fāʿil of an omitted verb indicated by the verb mentioned after it, the implied form being «إن ضربتم» ("if you travelled"); when the verb was omitted, the pronoun became detached. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes, the implied form being «إن ضربتم في الأرض فالشاهد آخران من غيركم» ("if you travel in the land, the witnesses are two others from outside you"), or «فاستشهدوا آخرين من غيركم» ("then call two others from outside you as witnesses"). The clause ﴿ضربتم﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya) with no grammatical position. ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿ضربتم﴾. The conditional clause has no grammatical position because it is parenthetical between the naʿt and what it qualifies, for His word ﴿تحبسونهما﴾ is a naʿt of His word ﴿آخران﴾.
﴿فأصابتكم مصيبة الموت﴾: The fāʾ: a conjunction for sequence with immediacy. «أصابتكم»: conjoined to ﴿ضربتم﴾. «مصيبة»: the fāʿil of «أصابتكم». «الموت»: muḍāf ilayhi. The clause ﴿أصابتكم...﴾ is conjoined to the parenthetical clause before it, with no grammatical position.
﴿تحبسونهما من بعد الصلاة﴾: «تحبسونهما»: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «من بعد»: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿تحبس﴾. «الصلاة»: muḍāf ilayhi. The clause ﴿تحبسونهما﴾ is a naʿt of ﴿آخران﴾, or resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿فيقسمان بالله إن ارتبتم لا نشتري به ثمنا﴾: The fāʾ is a conjunction. «يقسمان»: conjoined to ﴿تحبسونهما﴾. «بالله»: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿يقسمان﴾. «إن» is conditional. «ارتبتم»: a verb and its fāʿil, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes, and its implied form is «إن ارتبتم فيهما فحلفوهما» ("if you are in doubt about them, then make them swear"). The protasis together with its implied apodosis is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is parenthetical between the oath and its answer. «لا»: negating. «نشتري»: a nominative imperfect verb. The clause ﴿لانشتري...﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath. «به»: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿نشتري﴾. «ثمنًا»: a direct object.
﴿ولو كان ذا قربى﴾: The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). «لو» is conditional. «كان»: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun latent (mustatir), namely the one for whom the oath is sworn. «ذا»: the khabar of «كان». «قربى»: muḍāf ilayhi. The apodosis of ﴿لو﴾ is omitted, indicated by what precedes, i.e. «فلا نشتري به» ("we would still not sell it"). The conditional ﴿لو﴾ clause with what falls in its scope is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ولا نكتم شهادة الله إنا إذا لمن الآثمين﴾: The wāw is a conjunction, and the clause «لا نكتم» is conjoined to [the answer], falling in line with it under the ruling of the oath; «شهادة الله» is a direct object. «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; «إذًا» is a particle of answer and requital, inoperative (muhmala); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and ﴿من الآثمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the omitted khabar of «إن». The clause of «إن» with what falls in its scope has no grammatical position because it serves as the reason for not concealing.

muyesser-irab:107-107.t:
﴿فإن عثر على أنهما استحقا إثما﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive; «إن» is conditional; «عثر» is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «على أنهما» is a preposition and its genitive noun serving as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), i.e. «فإن اطلع على استحقاقهما الإثم» ("if it becomes known that they incurred sin"). «أن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the hāʾ is its noun; the clause «استحقا» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of «أن»; the alif is the fāʿil (agent) of «استحقا»; and «إثمًا» is the object of «استحقا».
﴿فآخران يقومان مقامهما من الذين استحق عليهم الأوليان﴾: The fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). «آخران» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يقومان» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar; or ﴿آخران﴾ is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, and the clause «يقومان» is in the position of the nominative as a naʿt (adjective). «مقامهما»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). «من الذين»: a naʿt of ﴿آخران﴾. The clause «استحق» has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; «عليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «استحق»; and «الأوليان» is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. «هما الأوليان» ("they are the two nearest of kin"), or the fāʿil of «استحق». The clause «فآخران» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. The clause ﴿فإن عثر...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿فيقسمان بالله لشهادتنا أحق من شهادتهما﴾: The fāʾ is a conjunction; «يقسمان» is an imperfect verb, nominative, conjoined to «يقومان», and the alif is the fāʿil; «بالله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «يقسمان»; the lām occurs in the answer to the oath; «شهادتنا» is a mubtadaʾ and «أحق» is the khabar; «من شهادتهما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أحق»; and the clause «شهادتنا» has no grammatical position because it occurs as the answer to the oath.
﴿وما اعتدينا إنا إذا لمن الظالمين﴾: The wāw is resumptive; «ما» is negating; «اعتدينا» is a past verb and its fāʿil. «إن» is an abrogating particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; «إذًا» is a particle of answer and requital, inoperative (muhmal); ﴿من الظالمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the omitted khabar of «إن»; and the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿وما اعتدينا...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:108-108.t:
﴿ذلك أدنى أن يأتوا بالشهادة على وجهها﴾: The demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أدنى» is the khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. «أن» with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar, genitive because the adverb is put in construct with it [Translator's note: so in the source, «مجرور بإضافة الظرف إليه», although «أدنى» has been parsed as a khabar, not an adverb]. «بالشهادة» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «يأتوا»; and «على وجهها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿أو يخافوا أن ترد أيمان بعد أيمانهم﴾: «أو» is a conjunction; «يخافوا» is conjoined to «يأتوا»; «أن» with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar, the object of «يخافوا»; «أيمان» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «ترد»; the adverb ﴿بعد﴾ is attached to ﴿ترد﴾; and «أيمانهم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿واتقوا الله واسمعوا﴾: The wāw is resumptive; «اتقوا الله» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «اسمعوا» is conjoined to «اتقوا»; and the clause ﴿واتقوا الله﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿والله لا يهدي القوم الفاسقين﴾: The wāw is resumptive; ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, the clause «لا يهدي» is the khabar, «القوم» is a direct object, and «الفاسقين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «القوم»; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿يا أيها الرسول لا يحزنك الذين يسارعون في الكفر﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (يا) is a vocative particle; (أي) is the one addressed (munādā), a specified indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of accusative; (ها) is for alerting (tanbīh); (الرسول) is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; (لا) is prohibitive; (يحزنك) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا); the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الذين) is a relative noun in the position of nominative as the fāʿil (agent); the clause (يسارعون) has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and (في الكفر) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يسارعون).
﴿من الذين قالوا آمنا بأفواههم ولم تؤمن قلوبهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause (قالوا) has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; the clause (آمنا) is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); (بأفواههم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (قالوا); the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl; (لم) is a particle of negation, inversion [of tense] and jussive; (تؤمن) is an imperfect verb, jussive by (لم); (قلوبهم) is the fāʿil; and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿ومن الذين هادوا سماعون للكذب سماعون لقوم آخرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and (من الذين هادوا) is conjoined to ﴿من الذين قالوا﴾, so that it is a ḥāl explaining a single thing; (سماعون) is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "they are avid listeners"; and (للكذب) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿سماعون﴾. Or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (من الذين) is a fronted khabar and (سماعون) a postponed mubtadaʾ, so that the explanation is of two things. The second ﴿سماعون﴾ is a badal (substitute) for the first ﴿سماعون﴾, or a tawkīd (emphasis) of it; (لقوم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿سماعون﴾; and (آخرين) is a naʿt.
﴿لم يأتوك﴾: the clause is a second naʿt of (قوم); (لم) is a particle of negation, inversion [of tense] and jussive; and (يأتوك) is a jussive imperfect verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿يحرفون الكلم من بعد مواضعه﴾: the clause is a third naʿt, and a muḍāf must be assumed to be omitted, i.e. "the ruling of the words"; (من بعد مواضعه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "while it is after Allah has put the words in their places"; or its meaning is "they distort the words from their places", so that ﴿بعد﴾ has been put in the place of ﴿عن﴾.
﴿يقولون إن أوتيتم هذا فخذوه﴾: the clause is a fourth naʿt. (يقولون) is an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (إن) is conditional; (أوتيتم) is a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named), in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (هذا) is the second object, the first being the tāʾ, which is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause (خذوه) is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and it was not fit to be the apodosis [without the fāʾ] because it is a request [Translator's note: the bracketed words are added for sense; the source's wording here is elliptical]; and the conditional clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
﴿وإن لم تؤتوه فاحذروا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إن) is conditional; (لم) is a particle of negation, inversion [of tense] and jussive; (تؤتوه) is an imperfect verb, jussive by (لم), and it is the protasis; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; the hāʾ is the second object; in (فاحذروا) the fāʾ links the apodosis; and the clause (احذروا) is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.
﴿ومن يرد الله فتنته فلن تملك له من الله شيئا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿من﴾ is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, in the position of nominative as a mubtadaʾ; ﴿يرد﴾ is the protasis; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; ﴿فتنته﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The fāʾ links the apodosis; ﴿لن﴾ is a particle of negation, accusative and future reference; ﴿تملك﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by (لن), and the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تملك﴾; ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl from ﴿شيئًا﴾; ﴿شيئًا﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi, or stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a qualifier of the maṣdar; and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of ﴿من﴾.
﴿أولئك الذين لم يرد الله أن يطهر قلوبهم﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ; (الذين) is the khabar; the clause ﴿لم يرد الله﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿أن﴾ and what falls within its scope are in the place of accusative as the object of (يرد); and (قلوبهم) is the mafʿūl bihi of (يطهر).
﴿لهم في الدنيا خزي﴾: (لهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (في الدنيا) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; (خزي) is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and the clause is a second khabar of the demonstrative.
﴿ولهم في الآخرة عذاب عظيم﴾: conjoined to what precedes. (لهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (في الآخرة) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; (عذاب) is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and (عظيم) is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿سماعون للكذب أكالون للسحت﴾: (سماعون) is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "they are avid listeners"; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (للكذب) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سماعون﴾; and likewise (أكالون للسحت).
﴿فإن جاءوك فاحكم بينهم أو أعرض عنهم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the speech after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. (إن) is conditional; (جاءوك) is a past verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (احكم) is an imperative verb; (بينهم) is an adverb attached to ﴿احكم﴾; (أو) is a conjunction for choice (takhyīr); (أعرض) is conjoined to ﴿احكم﴾; (عنهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أعرض﴾; and the clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.
﴿وإن تعرض عنهم فلن يضروك شيئا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إن) is conditional; (تعرض) is the protasis; (عنهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (تعرض); the fāʾ links the apodosis; (لن) is a particle of negation, accusative and future reference; (يضروك) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by (لن); the wāw is the fāʿil; the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi; (شيئًا) stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a qualifier of the maṣdar; and the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.
﴿وإن حكمت فاحكم بينهم بالقسط﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إن) is conditional; (حكمت) is a past verb and its fāʿil, in the position of jussive as the protasis; the fāʾ links the apodosis; (احكم) is an imperative verb; (بينهم) is an adverb attached to it; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; and (بالقسط) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "being just".
﴿إن الله يحب المقسطين﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); the clause (يحب المقسطين) is its khabar; and the clause is resumptive, giving the reason (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿وكيف يحكمونك وعندهم التوراة﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (كيف) is an interrogative of wonder (taʿajjub), in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); (يحكمونك) is a nominative imperfect verb; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the [next] wāw is for ḥāl; (عندهم) is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (التوراة) is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from the wāw in ﴿يحكمونك﴾.
﴿فيها حكم الله ثم يتولون من بعد ذلك﴾: (فيها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (حكم الله) is a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from (التوراة); (ثم) is a conjunction for sequence with delay; (يتولون) is conjoined to (يحكمونك); and (من بعد ذلك) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (يتولون), or a ḥāl.
﴿وما أولئك بالمؤمنين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating particle that operates like (ليس); ﴿أولئِك﴾ is a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on kasra in the position of nominative as the noun (ism) of (ما); the kāf is a particle of address; in ﴿بالمؤمنين﴾ the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and (المؤمنين) is the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive in form by the bāʾ.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿إنا أنزلنا التوراة﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (إن) is an abrogating particle; ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿أنزلنا﴾ is its khabar (predicate); and (التوراة) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فيها هدى ونور﴾: the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from (التوراة); (فيها) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar; (هدى) is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and (نور) is conjoined to (هدى).
﴿يحكم بها النبيون الذين أسلموا﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position, or a second ḥāl from (التوراة); (بها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (يحكم); (النبيون) is the fāʿil (agent) of (يحكم); (الذين) is a naʿt (adjective); and the clause (أسلموا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿للذين هادوا﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (يحكم), and the clause (هادوا) is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the meaning is "they judge by it among themselves"; or they are attached to (أنزلنا), or to an omitted naʿt of (هدى) and (نور).
﴿والربانيون والأحبار بما استحفظوا من كتاب الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (الربانيون) and (الأحبار) are conjoined to ﴿النبيون﴾; ﴿بما استحفظوا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (يحكم); (من كتاب الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (استحفظوا); (استحفظوا) is a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun) or a relative; and His word ﴿من كتاب الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. [Translator's note: the source gives two attachments for ﴿من كتاب الله﴾, presumably as alternatives.]
﴿وكانوا عليه شهداء﴾: conjoined to ﴿استحفظوا﴾; the wāw is the noun of (كان); (عليه) is attached to (شهداء); and (شهداء) is the khabar of (كانوا).
﴿فلا تخشوا الناس واخشون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, i.e. "if you know this, then do not fear people"; (لا) is prohibitive; (تخشوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive (لا); the wāw is the fāʿil; (الناس) is a mafʿūl bihi; in (واخشون) the wāw is a conjunction, and (اخشون) is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya); and the omitted yāʾ of the first person is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ولا تشتروا بآياتي ثمنا قليلا﴾: conjoined to what precedes. (لا) is prohibitive; (تشتروا) is an imperfect verb, jussive by (لا); (بآياتي) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (تشتروا), the bāʾ entering on the thing given up, as has been established; (ثمنا) is a mafʿūl bihi; and (قليلا) is a naʿt.
﴿ومن لم يحكم بما أنزل الله فأولئك هم الكافرون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. (من) is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, in the position of nominative as a mubtadaʾ; (لم) is a particle of negation, inversion [of tense] and jussive; (يحكم) is an imperfect verb, jussive by (لم), and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (بما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (يحكم); the clause (أنزل الله) is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; in ﴿فأولئك﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ; (هم) is a second mubtadaʾ; (الكافرون) is the khabar; the nominal clause is the khabar of the demonstrative; the clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of ﴿من﴾.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿وكتبنا عليهم فيها أن النفس بالنفس والعين بالعين والأنف بالأنف والأذن بالأذن والسن بالسن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (كتبنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the verb is conjoined to ﴿أنزلنا﴾; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كتبنا), and the pronoun in ﴿عليهم﴾ refers to those who are Jews; ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and the pronoun refers to the Torah; (أن) is an abrogating particle; (النفس) is its noun (ism); (بالنفس) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); (أن) and what follows it are interpreted as an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of (كتبنا), i.e. "the killing of the soul for the soul", i.e. "[the soul] being killed for the soul"; and (العين بالعين) is conjoined, i.e. "and the putting out of the eye for the putting out of the eye", "the cutting off of the nose for the cutting off of the nose", "the cutting off of the ear for the cutting off of the ear", and "the pulling out of the tooth for the pulling out of the tooth".
﴿والجروح قصاص﴾: likewise conjoined.
﴿فمن تصدق به فهو كفارة له﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. (من) is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, in the position of nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); (تصدق) is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (به) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (تصدق); the fāʾ links the apodosis; (هو) is a mubtadaʾ; (كفارة) is the khabar; the nominal clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of ﴿من﴾.
﴿ومن لم يحكم بما أنزل الله فأولئك هم الظالمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (من) is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, and it is a mubtadaʾ; (لم) is a particle of negation, inversion [of tense] and jussive; (يحكم) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لم), and it is the protasis; (بما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (يحكم); the clause (أنزل الله) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; in (فأولئك) the fāʾ links the apodosis; the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ; (هم) is a second mubtadaʾ; (الظالمون) is its khabar; the nominal clause ﴿هم الظالمون﴾ is the khabar of (أولئك); the clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of ﴿من﴾.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿وقفينا على آثارهم بعيسى ابن مريم مصدقا لما بين يديه من التوراة﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (قفينا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (على آثارهم) and (بعيسى) are a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قفينا); (ابن مريم) is a badal (substitute) or a naʿt (adjective); (مصدقًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial); (لما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿مصدقًا﴾; (بين يديه) is an adverb attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; and (من التوراة) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿وآتيناه الإنجيل فيه هدى ونور﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (آتيناه) is a past verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الإنجيل) is a second mafʿūl bihi; (فيه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (هدى) is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); (نور) is conjoined to (هدى); and the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿ومصدقا لما بين يديه من التوراة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (مصدقًا) is conjoined to the position of the [preceding] clause, so it has the status of an accusative ḥāl; (لما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿مصدقًا﴾; (بين يديه) is an adverb attached to the omitted ṣila of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; and (من التوراة) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿وهدى وموعظة للمتقين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (هدى) is conjoined, falling in line with ﴿مصدقًا﴾, so both are accusative as ḥāl, or both are objects of purpose (mafʿūl li-ajlihi); (موعظة) is conjoined to (هدى); and (للمتقين) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿وليحكم أهل الإنجيل بما أنزل الله فيه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the lām of command; (يحكم) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; (أهل الإنجيل) is the fāʿil (agent) of (يحكم); and (بما) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يحكم).
﴿ومن لم يحكم بما أنزل الله فأولئك هم الفاسقون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (من) is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, and it is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (لم) is a particle of negation, inversion [of tense] and jussive; (يحكم) is an imperfect verb, jussive by (لم), and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (بما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (يحكم); the clause (أنزل الله) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; in (فأولئك) the fāʾ links the apodosis; the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ; (هم) is a second mubtadaʾ; (الفاسقون) is its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause ﴿هم الفاسقون﴾ is the khabar of (أولئك); the clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of ﴿من﴾.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿وأنزلنا إليك الكتاب بالحق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (أنزلنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (إليك) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزلنا); and (بالحق) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from (الكتاب).
﴿مصدقا لما بين يديه من الكتاب﴾: (مصدقًا) is a ḥāl from (الكتاب); (لما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿مصدقًا﴾; (بين) is an adverb attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; (يديه) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (من الكتاب) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿ومهيمنا عليه فاحكم بينهم بما أنزل الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (مهيمنًا) is conjoined to ﴿مصدقًا﴾; (عليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿مهيمنًا﴾; (احكم) is an imperative verb; (بينهم) is an adverb attached to ﴿فاحكم﴾; (بما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (احكم); and the clause (أنزل الله) is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا تتبع أهواءهم عما جاءك من الحق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لا) is prohibitive; (تتبع) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive (لا); (أهواءهم) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (عما جاءك) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "deviating"; the clause (جاءك) is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; or ﴿تتبع﴾ carries the implied meaning of "deviate" or "be moved away", so that the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to it; and (من الحق) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil of (جاءك), or from the relative ﴿ما﴾ itself.
﴿لكل جعلنا منكم شرعة ومنهاجا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (لكل) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿جعلنا﴾, or it is the first object of (جعلنا); (منكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of the omitted noun, i.e. "for every community among you"; (شرعة) is the object of (جعلنا); and (منهاجًا) is conjoined to (شرعة).
﴿ولو شاء الله لجعلكم أمة واحدة﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. (لو) is conditional; (شاء الله) is a verb and its fāʿil; the lām occurs in the answer of (لو); the clause (جعلكم) has no grammatical position, because it occurs as the apodosis of a condition that does not make the verb jussive; (أمة) is the second object of (جعلكم); and (واحدة) is a naʿt.
﴿ولكن ليبلوكم في ما آتاكم﴾: the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl; (لكن) is a particle of rectification (istidrāk), inoperative because it is lightened; in (ليبلوكم) the lām is causal (li-l-taʿlīl), and (يبلوكم) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (أن) after the causal lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted element, its implied form being "أراد" ("He willed"); (فيما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (يبلوكم); and the clause (آتاكم) is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿فاستبقوا الخيرات إلى الله مرجعكم جميعا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, i.e. "if the wisdom in this has become clear to you, then race"; (استبقوا) is a verb and its fāʿil; (الخيرات) is a mafʿūl bihi, or accusative by removal of the preposition; (إلى الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (مرجعكم) is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; and (جميعًا) is a ḥāl from the kāf, because it is the agent in meaning, i.e. "you will return all together".
﴿فينبئكم بما كنتم فيه تختلفون﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to the meaning of (مرجعكم), i.e. "you will return, and He will inform you"; the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi; (بما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (ينبئكم); the clause (كنتم) is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the tāʾ is the noun (ism) of (كان); and the clause (تختلفون) is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:109-109.t:
﴿يوم يجمع الله الرسل فيقول ماذا أجبتم﴾: ﴿يوم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb whose implied form is «اذكر» ("remember"), i.e. «اذكر يوم يجمع الله الرسل» ("remember the day Allah gathers the messengers"); the implied clause ﴿اذكر﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿يجمع﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil (agent), and ﴿الرسل﴾ is a direct object. ﴿فيقول﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «يقول» is an imperfect verb conjoined to «يجمع». ﴿ماذا﴾ is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative, standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. «أيَّ إجابة أجبتم؟» ("What response were you given?"). It is also said: ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿ذا﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ ﴿ما﴾, and the clause ﴿أجبتم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative ﴿ذا﴾, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿ماذا أجبتم﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative.
﴿قالوا لا علم لنا إنك أنت علام الغيوب﴾: ﴿قالوا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. «لا» is the lā of generic negation; «علم» is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; «لنا» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to its omitted khabar; and the clause «لا علم لنا» is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying. «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the kāf is its noun; «أنت» is a mubtadaʾ, and «علام الغيوب» is the khabar of ﴿أنت﴾; the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of «إن»; and the clause of «إن» with what falls in its scope is causal (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:110-110.t:
﴿إذ قال الله يا عيسى ابن مريم﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) from ﴿يوم﴾ in His words, Exalted is He, ﴿يوم يجمع﴾; or in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb whose implied form is «اذكر» ("remember"). The clause ﴿قال﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يا﴾ is a vocative particle; ﴿عيسى﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), a single proper noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, in the position of the accusative; ﴿ابن﴾ is a badal (substitute) or a naʿt (adjective) of «عيسى»; and ﴿مريم﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿اذكر نعمتي عليك وعلى والدتك﴾: ﴿اذكر﴾ is an imperative verb, and ﴿نعمتي﴾ is a direct object. ﴿عليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿نعمتي﴾ if it is taken as a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. «اذكر إنعامي عليك» ("remember My bestowing favour on you"); or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿نعمتي﴾ if it is taken as a noun, i.e. «اذكر نعمتي كائنةً عليك» ("remember My favour, being upon you"). ﴿وعلى والدتك﴾: conjoined to the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عليك﴾.
﴿إذ أيدتك بروح القدس تكلم الناس في المهد وكهلا﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of past time attached to ﴿نعمتي﴾ if it is taken as a maṣdar, i.e. «إنعامي» ("My bestowing favour"); or it is a noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as a badal ishtimāl from ﴿نعمتي﴾. The clause ﴿أيدتك﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿بروح﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أيدتك»; and ﴿القدس﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause ﴿تكلم الناس﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the kāf in «أيدتك»; ﴿في المهد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «تُكلِّم», i.e. while you were an infant; and ﴿كهلًا﴾ is conjoined to it, so it too is a ḥāl.
﴿وإذ علمتك الكتاب والحكمة والتوراة والإنجيل﴾: The wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿إذ﴾ is conjoined to the earlier ﴿إذ﴾ in His words, Exalted is He, ﴿إذ أيدتك﴾. The clause ﴿علمتك﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; it is a verb, its fāʿil and a first direct object; ﴿الكتاب﴾ is a second direct object; and what follows it is conjoined to it.
﴿وإذ تخلق من الطين كهيئة الطير بإذني﴾: The wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿إذ﴾ is conjoined to the earlier ﴿إذ﴾ in His words, Exalted is He, ﴿إذ أيدتك﴾. The clause ﴿تخلق﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿من الطين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «تخلق». ﴿كهيئة﴾ — ﴿كهيئة﴾ [Translator's note: the word is repeated in the source]: the kāf is a noun meaning «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt of an omitted direct object, i.e. «شيئًا مثل هيئة الطير» ("something like the form of a bird"); «هيئة» is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿الطير﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; and ﴿بإذني﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿فتنفخ فيها فتكون طيرا بإذني﴾: The fāʾ: a conjunction. ﴿تنفخ﴾ is conjoined to «تخلق»; ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «تنفخ»; ﴿فتكون﴾ is conjoined to «فتنفخ»; ﴿طيرًا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of «تكون»; and ﴿بإذني﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿طيرا﴾.
﴿وتبرئ الأكمه والأبرص بإذني﴾: Conjoined to what preceded.
﴿وإذ تخرج الموتى بإذني﴾: The wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿إذ﴾ is conjoined to the earlier ﴿إذ﴾ in His words, Exalted is He, ﴿إذ أيدتك﴾. The clause ﴿تخرج﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿تخرج﴾ is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنت» ("you"); ﴿الموتى﴾ is a direct object; and ﴿بإذني﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil of «تخرج».
﴿وإذ كففت بني إسرائيل عنك﴾: The wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿إذ﴾ is conjoined to the earlier ﴿إذ﴾ in His words, Exalted is He, ﴿إذ أيدتك﴾. ﴿كففت﴾ is a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause ﴿كففت﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿بني إسرائيل﴾ is the object of «كففت»; and ﴿عنك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿كففت﴾.
﴿إذ جئتهم بالبينات فقال الذين كفروا منهم إن هذا إلا سحر مبين﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿كففت﴾; the clause ﴿جئتهم﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; and ﴿بالبينات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «جئتهم». ﴿فقال﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «قال» is a past verb conjoined to «جئتهم». ﴿الذين﴾ is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position; ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil of «كفروا». ﴿إن﴾ is negating; ﴿هذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction; ﴿سحر﴾ is the khabar of «هذا»; ﴿مبين﴾ is a naʿt; and the clause ﴿إن هذا إلا سحر مبين﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:111-111.t:
﴿وإذ أوحيت إلى الحواريين أن آمنوا بي وبرسولي﴾: The wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿إذ﴾ is conjoined to the earlier ﴿إذ﴾ in His words, Exalted is He, ﴿إذ أيدتك﴾. The clause ﴿أوحيت﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أن﴾: explicative (tafsīriyya), because revelation contains the meaning of saying without its letters, and the clause after it is explicative with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdar-forming, and together with what it enters upon it is interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar), accusative by removal of the preposition, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿أوحيت﴾; and the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdar-forming ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿قالوا آمنا واشهد بأننا مسلمون﴾: The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, and the clause «آمنا» is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). The bāʾ is a preposition; ﴿أن﴾ with what falls in its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar, genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿اشهد﴾; and «مسلمون» is the khabar (predicate) of «أنّ».

muyesser-irab:112-112.t:
﴿إذ قال الحواريون يا عيسى ابن مريم﴾: The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb whose implied form is «اذكر» ("remember"); the clause ﴿قال﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and «الحواريون» is the fāʿil (agent). «يا» is a vocative particle; «عيسى» is the one addressed (munādā), a single proper noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma; «ابن» is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عيسى﴾; and «مريم» is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿هل يستطيع ربك أن ينزل علينا مائدة من السماء﴾: The clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). «هل» is an interrogative particle; «يستطيع ربك» is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أن ينزل﴾: the maṣdar-forming ﴿أن﴾ and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar that is the object of «يستطيع»; «مائدة» is the object of «ينزل»; and «من السماء» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿ينزل﴾, or attached to an omitted naʿt of «مائدة».
﴿قال اتقوا الله إن كنتم مؤمنين﴾: The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, and the clause «اتقوا الله» is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying. «إن» is conditional; «كان» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), the tāʾ is its noun and «مؤمنين» is its khabar (predicate); «كان» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, understood from the context of the speech, i.e. if you believe in His power, Exalted is He, and in the truth of my prophethood, then avoid these obstinate questions.

muyesser-irab:113-113.t:
﴿قالوا نريد أن نأكل منها وتطمئن قلوبنا﴾: The speech is resumptive with no grammatical position. The clause «نريد» is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿أنْ﴾ with what falls in its scope is an interpreted maṣdar, the object of «نريد»; ﴿منها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿نأكل﴾; and «تطمئن قلوبنا» — the clause is conjoined to ﴿أن نأكل منها﴾.
﴿ونعلم أن قد صدقتنا ونكون عليها من الشاهدين﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; «نعلم» is conjoined to «نأكل». «أنْ» is lightened from the heavy [«أنّ»], and its noun is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the clause ﴿قد صدقتنا﴾ is its khabar (predicate). «نكون» is conjoined to «نعلم», and the noun of «نكون» is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «نحن» ("we"); ﴿من الشاهدين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the omitted khabar of «نكون»; and «عليها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «الشاهدين».

muyesser-irab:114-114.t:
﴿قال عيسى ابن مريم﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «قال عيسى» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «ابن» is a badal (substitute) or a naʿt (adjective); and «مريم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿اللهم ربنا أنزل علينا مائدة من السماء﴾: «اللهم» is originally «يا الله» ("O Allah"); the vocative particle was omitted and the doubled mīm was given in compensation for it. «ربنا» is a second vocative; «أنزل» is a verb of supplication, and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun whose implied form is «أنت» ("you"); «علينا» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «أنزل»; «مائدة» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and «من السماء» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted naʿt of «مائدة», or likewise attached to «أنزل».
﴿تكون لنا عيدا لأولنا وآخرنا وآية منك﴾: The clause «تكون» is a second naʿt of «مائدة», i.e. the day of its descent will be a festival. The noun of «تكون» is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هي» ("it"), and ﴿عيدًا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of «تكون»; «لنا» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿لأولنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted [element] that is a badal from ﴿لنا﴾ with repetition of the governor; «آخرنا» is conjoined to ﴿أولنا﴾; «آية» is conjoined to ﴿عيدًا﴾; and «منك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted naʿt of «آية».
﴿وارزقنا وأنت خير الرازقين﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; «ارزقنا» is a verb of supplication, its fāʿil latent, and «نا» is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as a direct object. The wāw is resumptive or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «أنت» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and «خير الرازقين» is the khabar; and the clause has no grammatical position because it is resumptive, or it is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:115-115.t:
﴿قال الله إني منزلها عليكم﴾: Resumptive speech with no grammatical position. «إني» with what falls in its scope is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the yāʾ is its noun, and «منزلها» is the khabar (predicate); «عليكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «منزلها» because it is an active participle.
﴿فمن يكفر بعد منكم﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive; «من» is a jussive-governing conditional noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); «يكفر» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «بعد» is an adverb cut off from the iḍāfa in wording but not in meaning, so it is indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and it is attached to «يكفر»; and «منكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فإني أعذبه عذابا لا أعذبه أحدا من العالمين﴾: The fāʾ links the apodosis. «إن» is an abrogating particle, the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause «أعذبه» is its khabar; the clause «إني أعذبه» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿عذابا﴾ stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) because it is a noun of maṣdar. ﴿لا﴾ is negating, and «أعذبه» is an imperfect verb; the pronoun in the second ﴿أعذبه﴾ stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq because it refers back to it, the implied form being «فإني أعذبه تعذيبًا لا أعذب مثل ذلك التعذيب أحدًا» ("I will punish him with a punishment the like of which I will not inflict on anyone"); or the hāʾ refers back to the ﴿مَن﴾ that came before in His words ﴿فمَن يكفر﴾, and the meaning is «لا أعذب مثل عذاب الكافر أحدا» ("I will not punish anyone with the like of the disbeliever's punishment"); and these two muḍāfs must be supposed for the meaning to be sound. ﴿أحدًا﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the negated clause is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عذابًا﴾; and ﴿من العالمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿أحدًا﴾. The clause of the protasis and its apodosis is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿من﴾, and the clause ﴿فمن يكفر...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:116-116.t:
﴿وإذ قال الله يا عيسى ابن مريم﴾: The wāw: a conjunction; ﴿إذ﴾ is conjoined to the earlier ﴿إذ﴾ in His words, Exalted is He, ﴿إذ قال الحواريون﴾. The clause ﴿قال الله﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause ﴿يا عيسى ابن مريم﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿أأنت قلت للناس اتخذوني وأمي إلهين من دون الله﴾: The hamza is interrogative; «أنت» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «قلت للناس» is the khabar (predicate); the interrogative clause is the object of the saying. The clause «اتخذوني», made up of the imperative verb, the fāʿil (agent) and the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying. ﴿وأمي﴾: the wāw is for accompaniment or conjunction, and «أمي» is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment) or conjoined to the yāʾ; «إلهين» is the second direct object of «اتخذوني»; and «من دون الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «إلهين», i.e. «كائنين من دونه تعالى» ("being apart from Him, Exalted is He"), or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of «اتخذوني», i.e. «متجاوزين» ("going beyond [Him]").
﴿قال سبحانك﴾: «قال» is a past verb; «سبحانك»: it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative by an omitted verb, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; together with its omitted verb it is a parenthetical clause with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿قال سبحانك...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿ما يكون لي أن أقول ما ليس لي بحق﴾: «ما» is negating; «يكون» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb; «لي» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the omitted khabar of «يكون», placed first; and ﴿أن﴾ with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) that is the noun of «يكون», placed later. The clause ﴿ما يكون لي...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿ليس﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the noun of «ليس» is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هو» ("it"); ﴿بحق﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and «حق» is the khabar of «ليس»; «لي» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it has been placed before what it qualifies. «ما» is a relative noun, the object of ﴿أقول﴾, because it comprises the meaning of a sentence.
﴿إن كنت قلته فقد علمته﴾: The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. «إن» is conditional; «كنت» is an incomplete past verb, the tāʾ is its noun, and the incomplete verb is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the clause ﴿قلته﴾ is the khabar of «كنت»; the fāʾ is linking; the clause «قد علمته» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the jussive-governing condition; and «علمته» is a verb, its fāʿil and a direct object.
﴿تعلم ما في نفسي ولا أعلم ما في نفسك﴾: The clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. «ما» is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as a direct object; «في نفسي» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted [verb that is the] ṣila of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿لا أعلم ما في نفسك﴾ is conjoined to what preceded.
﴿إنك أنت علام الغيوب﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the kāf is its noun; «أنت» is a mubtadaʾ and «علام الغيوب» is the khabar, and the clause is the khabar of ﴿إن﴾; or ﴿أنت﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) and «علام» is the khabar of ﴿إن﴾. The clause «إنك» with what follows it has no grammatical position because it is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:117-117.t:
﴿ما قلت لهم إلا ما أمرتني به﴾: «ما» is negating; «قلت» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «لهم» is attached to «قلت»; «إلا» is a particle of restriction; «ما» is a relative noun, the object of «قلت»; and the clause «أمرتني به» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿أن اعبدوا الله ربي وربكم﴾: ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar from «أن اعبدوا» is a badal (substitute) from ﴿ما﴾, or from the hāʾ in ﴿به﴾, or the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject) whose implied form is «هو» ("it is"); the clause ﴿اعبدوا الله﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdar-forming ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it is explicative with no grammatical position. ﴿ربي﴾ is a badal from ﴿الله﴾ or a naʿt (adjective).
﴿وكنت عليهم شهيدا ما دمت فيهم﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; «كنت» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), the tāʾ is its noun and «شهيدًا» is its khabar; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ﴿شهيدًا﴾. ﴿ما دمت﴾ is an incomplete past verb, the tāʾ is its noun, and «فيهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to its omitted khabar; the adverb formed from ﴿ما دمت﴾ is attached to ﴿شهيدًا﴾, i.e. «مدة دوامي مستقرًّا فيهم» ("for the duration of my remaining among them").
﴿فلما توفيتني كنت أنت الرقيب عليهم﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive. «لما» is temporal (ḥīniyya), or linking [Translator's note: so in the source, «أو رابطة»], in which case it is an adverb; or it is a particle comprising the sense of condition. The clause «توفيتني» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), or has no grammatical position; «توفيتني» is a verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. You took me fully by raising me to heaven. The clause ﴿كنت﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. «كنت» is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; «أنت» is a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun in «كنت», or a detached pronoun with no grammatical position [Translator's note: i.e. a separating pronoun, ḍamīr faṣl]; «الرقيب»: the khabar of «كنت»; «عليهم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «الرقيب».
﴿وأنت على كل شيء شهيد﴾: The wāw is resumptive or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «أنت» is a mubtadaʾ and «شهيد» is the khabar; «على كل شيء» is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to «شهيد»; and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, or in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
